Avalonia parity ledger

The single source of truth for "done" in the WPF -> Avalonia 12 port. One row per WPF window, view, dialog, control, theme dictionary, shell partial and platform feature. The WPF head (ConditioningControlPanel/) is the reference: a row is done when the Avalonia counterpart matches it or is better, and is at least as fast.

Status, lowest to highest:

  • missing: no Avalonia counterpart.
  • stub: a counterpart exists but key behaviour is a placeholder, unwired or unavailable.
  • wired: the counterpart implements the WPF behaviour as far as the source shows, and something in the Avalonia head opens or hosts it. Not yet proven. A surface nothing opens is stub, and so is one missing a WPF animation or motion effect.
  • verified: proven on Linux by a headless test or render proof AND a Keincheck run on the live app (navigate, click, read state, screenshot), compared against the WPF reference. Evidence linked.
  • improved: verified, and deliberately better than WPF; the reason is in avalonia-decisions.html.
  • blocked: cannot progress yet; the blocker is in the notes. Revisit later.
  • resolved: a contract/decision row (no surface of its own) whose blocker was answered; answer and date in the notes.

--render-all (RenderProof) only proves a view draws; it never makes a row verified on its own. Initial statuses were read from source on 2026-09-28 (stack tip #1765) and are not yet verified.

Locking a row: a verified/improved row must have a snapshot, or the gate fails (ledger-snapshot-check.sh). Add the row id and its window to Rows in Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Snapshot.Tests/VerifiedRowSnapshotTests.cs, run that project once, read Snapshots/<row-id>.received.png, rename it (and the .received.txt tree) to .verified.*. It renders through the RenderProof setup (Inter, Skia, Motion off, throwaway profile) with the bundled Noto Emoji pinned as the fallback font, so it matches on ubuntu-latest, and compares by SSIM 0.995. Accept a new or changed baseline only with the WPF side-by-side image path in the commit message.

Starting totals (2026-09-28): 362 rows: 59 missing, 247 stub, 56 wired, 0 verified.

Merge reconciliation: one row per ID, with evidence from both lanes retained. Advanced implementation statuses take precedence; historical absence claims are superseded by later implementation details. No row is promoted to verified by this merge.

Notes carry what is stubbed or missing, platform-specific parts, existing evidence and, where it matters, a performance note (startup, tab switch, list scroll, overlays, media).

shell-rememberConditioningControlPanel/MainWindow/MainWindow.Remember.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/MainShellWindow.Remember.cs; CCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/MainShellWindow.axaml; CCP.Core/Models/RememberedConfig.cswiredClick snapshots/recalls the one slot (Preset + Takeover/Awareness/Haptics through the tab checkboxes + browser-mute flag, LockdownStrictHold), right-click re-saves, both refused mid-session; star/tooltip synced at startup (InitializeRememberButton) and localized in 9 languages. Differs from WPF: a recall runs CoreEngine.Reconcile (as LoadPreset does), which stops running features the recalled setup turns off; WPF Remember only refreshes the rail. Gaps: browser mute flag saved but not applied live (WebHost has no mute, same refusal as shell-browser); no keyboard path for the right-click overwrite (none in WPF either). Test: Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/RememberButtonTests.cs (fail-proven: init call, right-click overwrite, both session refusals, recall ApplyTo). Live (sandbox): ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-cloud-remember/live.log (☆ -> ★ after invoking #BtnRemember, 0 binding errors) + shell-remember-after-click.png. Historical lane note (superseded by current evidence above): Remember/snapshot and recall handlers are empty; Earlier evidence (superseded where the current description differs): Click snapshots/recalls the one slot (Preset + Takeover/Awareness/Haptics through the tab checkboxes + browser-mute flag, LockdownStrictHold), right-click re-saves, both refused mid-session; Merged duplicate row also said: Remember/snapshot and recall handlers are empty; no service-backed session state.
shell-remote-controlConditioningControlPanel/MainWindow/MainWindow.RemoteControl.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/MainShellWindow.RemoteControl.cs; CCP.Avalonia/Views/Tabs/RemoteControlTabView.axaml.csstubClient ported (remote-control-core): Core CCP.Core/Services/RemoteControl/RemoteRelay.cs owns WPF RemoteControlService's relay protocol (start/stop/poll/status, PIN, pairing URL, 429 backoff, 401x3/404 endings, controller connect/idle + 120 s idle auto-disconnect, stop-effects-on-disconnect, refusals reported as status: fail + reason); RemoteCommandGate refuses disable_panic always and enable_strict_lock under Lockdown (escape integrity, avalonia-decisions.html 2026-09-30; restraint-reducing verbs run as WPF and leave the Lockdown timer alone); RemoteCommands routes verbs to Core (flash, subliminal, bubbles, bouncing text, video, bubble count, lock card, haptics, ducking, strict, panic stop) and refuses the rest "not on this build". Sandbox: CCP_REMOTE_BASE_URL loopback-only, else no relay. WPF delegates poll/backoff/idle constants, PIN, pairing URL and command labels. Tests Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/RemoteRelayTests.cs (fake relay, fail-proven). rows-remote-control: the shell half is wired from startup (InitializeRemoteControlOverlay, CCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/MainShellWindow.RemoteControl.cs): controller overlay with 300/200 ms fades, session code + PIN, idle subtitle (orange, new key label_controller_may_be_idle in 9 languages), session info card from Core SessionRunner (name, mm:ss / mm:ss, PAUSED, phase), big emote picker 3 above / 2 below + custom box + End Session (stops the relay; the tab unticks on SessionEnded), 2 s command toast (quiet verbs none), controller-joined OS notification, Start button locked green 🎮 REMOTE CONNECTED and restored on leave/end (UpdateStartButton keeps the label, Start click refused while connected). One timer only while the overlay is up: 1 s (WPF session-info cadence), 100 ms only while a toast or fade-out is pending. Panic/leave semantics unchanged. Not live (needs a paired controller). Flash images now open overlays through this (feat-flash; X11Overlay.SetOpacity added: compositor-side alpha, because re-rendering the overlays each fade frame on GLX/XWayland stalled the UI dispatcher ~1.7 s per burst). RestackAbove has no Win32 half (HWND_TOPMOST is assumed to cover it; not run on Windows). Risk: SetOverrideRedirect sizes by DesktopScaling, which on mixed-DPI Windows comes from the monitor the window was created on, so an overlay on a different-DPI screen may be mis-sized (the CI check has one screen). Existing PanicSurfaces tour stop remains the owner. Native X11/Windows input changes compiled, not run against a desktop here; native Wayland without XWayland remains unsupported. shell-single-instanceConditioningControlPanel/App.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Program.cs; CCP.Avalonia/App.axaml.cswiredCCP.Avalonia/Platform/SingleInstance.cs, claimed in Program.cs before the desktop lifetime: WPF's mutex name ConditioningControlPanel_SingleInstance_Mutex (installer AppMutex); a second launch asks the primary to show (ShowFromTray on its UI thread), waits up to WPF's 10 s for the ack and exits 0; no listener = WPF's 8 s mid-update wait, then exit; listener without ack = 3 s wait then run. Show/ack go over a named pipe (Unix socket on Linux) because WPF's named EventWaitHandles do not exist on Unix, so an Avalonia second launch cannot wake a running WPF build. A CCP_USERDATA_DIR sandbox suffixes the names so kc/tests never touch the user's app (SingleInstanceTests.ASandboxProfileIsItsOwnInstance, fail-proven by dropping the suffix). Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/SingleInstanceTests.cs (fail-proven: no show -> count 0; no ack -> second not null). Live: published linux-x64 build, second launch exit 0 in 0 s with first still up (~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/publish-profiles/shell-single-instance-live.txt). Not verified: no Keincheck run (Release publish). Launcher handoff (launcher-boot): the request carries the Core LauncherHandoff payload (length byte + UTF-8; 0 = bare relaunch) in place of WPF's handoff file, routed by LauncherWindow.RouteHandoff; SingleInstanceTests.SecondLaunchHandsItsSurfaceToThePrimary fail-proven; live ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port-launcher-boot/win-launcher-handoff.txt. On Unix .NET's named mutex is session-scoped, so a second launch from another login session (e.g. setsid) does not find the primary. Not ported: stale-instance kill (KillStaleInstances), "Open with CCP" file handoff, the startup-phase early ack. Merged duplicate row also said: Avalonia lifetime starts normally; no mutex, process forwarding, acknowledgment gate or zombie takeover. Historical evidence (superseded where current behavior above closes a gap): Avalonia lifetime starts normally; no mutex, process forwarding, acknowledgment gate or zombie takeover. Still missing on this head: no race window or launcher tile (host shell RaceWindow.Host: boot/init, payout, watchdog, grants), BambiCloud levels (game-race-b), own tracks/charting UI (game-race-c), the track player and its LibVLC decoder seed (game-race-d). game-race-b: host shell. race is a GameWindow game (dtrh/race.html) behind RacingAccess (WPF CaucusHostService.cs:132); Avalonia seeds RacingAccess.IsGrantedProvider = PrizeOwnership.IsGranted (App.axaml.cs, P31); the launcher tile goes through the account + leash steps; panic closes it (PanicSurfaces "games"). Host frames: init with the race settings block + manifest (:255), run-started/run-ended one payout (score/5, 250 XP/min, Sparks via ChaosMeta.AwardRunRewards) (:336, :431), ping-then-close heartbeat watch (:595), teardown + presence (:686). Tests: GameWindowTests Race_* (door/launcher/leash/panic, boot + one payout, watchdog), fail-proven. Still stub: no Back Room mystery card (an unowned race has no tile), settings.cloud=false (BambiCloud levels: next unit, then own tracks, then the player), track-, sfx/fire-payload, favorites/loom-list, report-bug, fullscreen-set, video pause, grants watcher, meta frame, bubble credit, SeasonRecap TrackFeature, Esc-as-pause (PostKeptEscape :95-119), audio-web pack request (:147), EmiDesk NoteOpen (:144), creator-mod content (modContent null), the graceful exit-request close on panic (:233; panic closes outright), and the race's own sfx (CCP.Avalonia.csproj:121 excludes dtrh/assets/**/.mp3, so pops are silent). Fail-proofs: ~/ccp-port/evidence/review-game-race-b/failproofs.md. game-dtrhConditioningControlPanel/Services/Chaos/DtrhHostService.cs, ConditioningControlPanel/Services/Chaos/DtrhAssetManifest.cs, Assets/web/dtrh/index.htmlCCP.Avalonia/Views/Games/GameWindow.Dtrh.cs, CCP.Core/Services/Chaos/DtrhRunWire.cs, DtrhRunPayoutRule.cs, DtrhRunCloseRule.cs, GameMediaManifest.cs, DtrhMotionWire.cs, CCP.Core/Services/Safety/PanicPolicy.cs, CCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/MainShellWindow.PanicKey.csstubDown the Rabbit Hole. game-dtrh-host (slice A): dtrh registered on GameWindow (dtrh/index.html off WebAssetServer) behind WPF's Lab door (LauncherCatalogue :241, TierGate.DemandLab, daily-free drop honoured), launcher tile (Play opens it); ready -> init (protocol, masterVolume, motionLevel = DtrhMotionWire.Current(), modId, runSetup, m2Test false) then the local manifest (images + videos, GameMediaManifest moved to Core, Frame shared with the race); request-run persists the hub's setup and deals run-config (scripted first descent when RunsCompleted == 0); run-started / run-progress / run-ended pay XP + Sparks once per descent (DtrhRunWire.Book, score capped at 250 XP/min x difficulty, a left descent paid by the host's clock); a window closed mid-descent banks its last snapshot (DtrhRunCloseRule). Escape as panic key with the DTRH window in front is its pause (PanicPolicy.GameClaimsEscapeAsPause, kept-escape posted when ready); a second Escape inside 2 s is a full panic that closes it (PanicSurfaces "games", no exit rung). The WPF host now calls the same Core rules (DtrhRunWire: RunSetup/PersistRunSetup/Deal/RunConfig/Book; ChaosHappyPath.BuildFirstRunConfig -> DtrhRunWire.FirstRunConfig); DtrhRunPayoutRule/DtrhRunCloseRule + tests git mv'd to Core. Tests: Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/DtrhRunWireTests.cs, GameWindowTests.Dtrh_LabDoor_BootRunLifecycle_AndCloseBanks, GameWindowTests.Dtrh_EscapePauses_ASecondEscapeInsideTwoSecondsClosesIt, fail-proven (~/ccp-port/evidence/review-game-dtrh-host/fail-proofs.txt). game-dtrh-host-b: the manifest's online half moved to Core DtrhRemoteMedia (WPF DtrhAssetManifest calls it with RemoteMediaCache as copier): with the source off "local" and consent, the cached pool (dtrh_remote_media.json) rides on the library, copies land in <assets>/.temp/ccp_temp_remote_* (WebAssetServer serves exactly those) and re-post the manifest, loops lane, loops-dry 30 min back-off, "online" + 8 copies steps the library aside; the licence day limit (main-sync-7 a1a08fce2) lives there too: an entry and a copy live 24 h (RemoteEntryFresh, a stale copy is released when the manifest is built), WPF's hourly ScrolllerCopySweeper reaches the copies through DtrhRemoteMedia.SweepLocalCopies (this head has no copy sweeper yet, lane sync7-scrolller); the manifest's urls are root-relative (WebAssetServer.AssetPath) because hostMedia.js counts 127.0.0.1 urls as remote and kept the library out of the tube's WebGL layer. Tests Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/DtrhRemoteMediaTests.cs, GameWindowTests.Dtrh_OnlineCopiesLand_TheManifestIsRepostedWithThemAsAssetUrls, IntakePageTests.TheAssetsPrefixServesOnlyActiveLibraryMedia (~/ccp-port/evidence/review-game-dtrh-host-b/fail-proofs.txt). Still missing (lane game-dtrh-host-c): the meta bridge (meta snapshot / meta-command, Warren shelves), the ccp.art / ccp.spirals / ccp.content / ccp.mod origins (bubble art, loom gifs, audio pack, mod content), loom-list/loom-*, favorites/asset-stats, heartbeat watchdog + relaunch-once, barks, sfx, fire-payload, freeze/mute, vn-speaking, haptics, fullscreen-set, report-bug, session stats, bubble credit, RevealService.Sync, crash sentinel, EMI desk fires, audio-web pack request, tucking the panel to the tray, SeasonRecap TrackFeature, the Play-tab/Exclusives doors, and kept-escape for race/board/Breakout. Known deviations: a panic closes the window at once (PanicSurfaces "games" -> GameWindow.CloseAllForPanic) where WPF GameSurfaces.cs:51 -> DtrhHostService.CloseActive posts end-run and force-closes after 1200 ms, so a panic banks the last run-progress snapshot (up to ~10 s old; nothing when the descent is younger than its first snapshot); ChaosRunState.SkillMultProvider is never seeded on this head, so payout-result.skillMult is always 1.0 (same gap as game-race); GameMediaManifest moved to Core with edits (namespace, BuildLocal(Func), BuildActive, Frame; ~82% similarity) and has no WPF user yet. Core Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/PanicPolicyDtrhTests.cs pins KeptEscapeGoesTo -> Dtrh. dtrh-feel-port: DtrhMotionWire git mv to Core (~/ccp-port/evidence/review-dtrh-feel-port/fail-proofs.txt). Per-commit status: avalonia-main-sync-dtrh-feel.html. Live steps: ~/ccp-port/evidence/live-queue/webview.md (game-dtrh-host).
shell-clickthrough-overlaysConditioningControlPanel/Services/Notifications/OverlayService.cs; ConditioningControlPanel/Services/Compositor/LayeredCompositorHost.cs; ConditioningControlPanel/Overlays/CCP.Avalonia/Platform/X11Overlay.cs; CCP.Avalonia/Views/Overlays/PinkFilterOverlay.cs; CCP.Avalonia/Views/Overlays/TintOverlayWindow.cs; CCP.Avalonia/Views/Chaos/ChaosOverlayWindow.axaml.cs; CCP.Avalonia/X11OverlayProbe.cs; CCP.Avalonia/OverlayCheck.csstubMechanism (docs/avalonia-decisions.html, desktop overlays): X11 backend pinned on Linux (Program.BuildAvaloniaApp UseX11(); Wayland sessions run via XWayland), non-focus overlay = override-redirect ARGB window + empty XFixes input region, both set before Show() (X11Overlay.SetOverrideRedirect(window, bounds), which sets override-redirect before any geometry so the WM cannot replay a stale size after map, + SetClickThrough). --overlay-check reads back per screen from the X server: XID exists and is unmapped before Show, then map_state=IsViewable, override_redirect=True, depth 32, 0 input rects, geometry == Screens bounds; 25/25 consecutive PASS live on this box (XDG_SESSION_TYPE=wayland, 3 screens; overlay-check-loop-25.txt) and in nested kwin; fails (exit 1) with override-redirect skipped. --x11-probe covers click-through toggle + restack. Evidence ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/x11-override-redirect/. Flash images now open overlays through this (feat-flash; X11Overlay.SetOpacity added: compositor-side alpha, because re-rendering the overlays each fade frame on GLX/XWayland stalled the UI dispatcher ~1.7 s per burst). Windows (win32-overlay-shim): the same entry points route an "HWND" handle to CCP.Avalonia/Platform/Win32Overlay.cs (WS_EX_LAYERED|TOOLWINDOW + WS_EX_TRANSPARENT|NOACTIVATE toggled together, kept through Avalonia's style rebuilds via Win32Properties.AddWindowStylesCallback, HWND_TOPMOST, LWA_ALPHA opacity; WPF bits from OverlayService.cs:1415, FlashService.cs:4614/:4838); dispatch covered by Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/OverlayBackendDispatchTests.cs; compiled for win-x64 only, never run here - verified only by the windows CI --overlay-check step (user32 read-back, SKIP without a desktop session). RestackAbove has no Win32 half. Risk: SetOverrideRedirect sizes by DesktopScaling, which on mixed-DPI Windows comes from the monitor the window was created on, so an overlay on a different-DPI screen may be mis-sized (the CI check has one screen). Still stub: tutorial spotlight hole/rect input remains unavailable.

win-achievement-popupConditioningControlPanel/Windows/AchievementPopup.xaml, AchievementPopup.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/AchievementPopup.axaml, AchievementPopup.axaml.cswiredOpened by App.WireAchievementUnlocks (startup) on every engine Unlocked, then WPF OnAchievementUnlocked's tail: achievement sound (bundled chime2 - Linux has no SystemSounds.Asterisk) and the opt-in community post (Core DiscordAccount.SendAchievementWebhookAsync/ModThemeId, moved from WPF DiscordService; WPF forwards). Passive toast: AchievementPopup.PlacePassive = bottom-right in device pixels + X11 override-redirect (no focus, no taskbar, above fullscreen); folder image names (skills/...) resolve as WPF. Headless: AchievementUnlockAnnounceTests (chime + post only when sharing is on + corner/stack math, each fail-proven). Live: ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/rows-popups-unlock/ (level-up -> popup 400x200 not active, not in _NET_CLIENT_LIST; share path logs WPF's no-unified-id refusal). Live bounds + click-to-dismiss: rows-popups-unlock/toast-positions.txt (synthetic kc click). Deviation: the chime follows MasterVolume; WPF's SystemSounds.Asterisk ignores it. Windows head keeps WS_EX_NOACTIVATE on these toasts (Win32Overlay passive). Not here: the bubble-milestone and SkillTree streak/perfect-week callers (their own rows); native Wayland has no override-redirect (placed + ShowActivated=False only). win-bubble-count-resultConditioningControlPanel/Windows/BubbleCountResultWindow.xaml, BubbleCountResultWindow.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/BubbleCountResultWindow.axaml, BubbleCountResultWindow.axaml.cswiredOpened by every game's clip end (bubble-count-live). XP is WPF's 250 scaled by the clip length through Core BubbleCountScheduler.ScaleXpByDuration (live 12 s clip: "CORRECT! +50 XP"); 3 attempts, hints, strict text, mercy lock card; keys follow MandatoryVideoScheduler.KeyAction (strict falls open without a panic listener). Proof: Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/BubbleCountGameTests.cs (answer -> XP -> completion), live ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/bubble-count-live/win-bubble-count-result.txt. XP banks only when signed in (as WPF); not verified: no screenshot on a locked session, no WPF side-by-side. win-bubble-countConditioningControlPanel/Windows/BubbleCountWindow.xaml, BubbleCountWindow.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/BubbleCountWindow.axaml, BubbleCountWindow.axaml.csstubEarlier ledger evidence (retained for history; implementation details above supersede older absence claims): Real game (bubble-count-live): one LibVLC decoder on LibVlcAudio.Shared through VlcFrameSink feeds an Image in every game window (DualMonitorEnabled), master volume, LengthChanged re-times target/safety clock, EndReached/error -> answer window, player paused behind it, TrackVideoWatched, count bubbles + pop sounds; strict swallows panic key/Alt+F4 while the panic listener is live and falls open without one; engine stop/panic closes it. Proof: Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/BubbleCountGameTests.cs (frames reach the window, answer, strict, fall-open, panic), live ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/bubble-count-live/. Still stub: WPF's MA_NOACTIVATE hook (a click can raise the game over its bubble windows until the next spawn), browser (WebView2) engine, metadata-cache duration, VideoService wedge/poison guards. Without LibVLC the game is skipped, not counted as a failure, so strict mode never retries it (WPF BubbleCountService.cs:373; BubbleCountQueueTests.StrictGameWithoutLibVlcIsSkippedNotRetried, fail-proven).
win-bug-reportConditioningControlPanel/Windows/BugReportWindow.xaml, BugReportWindow.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/BugReportWindow.axaml, BugReportWindow.axaml.cswiredBugReportWorkflowTests; render-all. main-sync 20261005 bfe45f6db (port-shellcopy): Topmost + Activate on open; test ShellCopyPortTests.BugReportStaysAboveOverlays. audit-fix-misc (#1289): a recent hang_*.txt pre-ticks "include log" and shows TxtHangHint (WPF BugReportWindow.xaml.cs:87-101); BugReportWorkflowTests.RecentFreezePreTicksIncludeLogAndShowsHint (fail-proven).
win-corner-gifConditioningControlPanel/Windows/CornerGifWindow.xaml, CornerGifWindow.xaml.cs, ConditioningControlPanel/Services/CornerGifService.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/CornerGifWindow.axaml, CornerGifWindow.axaml.cs, CCP.Avalonia/Views/Overlays/CornerGifOverlay.cswiredDialog: render-all, settings persist. Overlay (rows-corner-gif): CornerGifOverlay seeded as CoreCornerGif.RefreshHandler from App startup (WPF App.xaml.cs:480), so the dialog's switches/corner/size/opacity and the Spiral card's pool pick rebuild live (one slot for a slider edit, all for a switch/corner). WPF CornerGifService rules: max 2 slots, primary screen, CornerGifPlanner placement + 40 DIP same-corner nudge, 400 ms realization stagger, 8x250 ms deferral while DisplayChangeCoordinator.SpawnsSuppressed, per-slot generation so a teardown cancels a queued show, art = slot pick -> pool spiral -> mod spiral -> shipped spiral_corner.gif (now linked), frames decoded off the UI thread at the overlay's pixel size, one frame swap per tick; override-redirect + empty input shape (click-through, no focus, no taskbar) like the other X11 overlays; no compositor -> not shown (logged). #709/#954/#958 restore sentinel (logs/cornergif_restore.active, armed while any overlay is up or pending): restored at ApplicationIdle; a surviving sentinel force-disables the slots with a 12 s warning toast (corner_gif_force_disabled, 9 languages). Panic: PanicSurfaces 'corner-gif' (after 'engine', WPF :1967) closes and cancels, settings untouched; shell close stops them. Lockdown: WPF applies none to this surface (no Lockdown check in CornerGifService/CornerGifWindow). Test CornerGifOverlayTests (dialog switch -> overlay in the corner, animates, stagger + nudge, panic key, sentinel force-disable; App seed scan) fail-proven 4 ways (panic line removed, stagger removed, force-disable removed, App seed removed); PanicSurfacesTests order updated. Live (sandbox, XWayland/KWin, 1.79x): ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/rows-corner-gif/live-run.txt: restore -> 2 override-redirect depth-32 windows 538x358 and 269x179 at the bottom-right with input_rects=0, second nudged ~72 px; kill -9 with overlays up -> next launch 0 windows, slots [False, False], force-disabled warning logged; 0 binding errors. Panic is proven headless only: the live XTest F8 (panic-run.txt) never reached the listener (the sandbox shell was not viewable, XSetInputFocus BadMatch), so the overlays stayed up there. Deviations: one frame delay per GIF (the SpiralFrames plan, 20-500 ms else 50 ms) where WPF's decoder plays per-frame delays; opacity is painted on the image, not the window. Not here: the session-scoped corner GIF (WPF SessionEngine: start/end minute, session/standalone admission and handback, SessionCornerGifAllowed) - see shell-presets; WPF's hang-report/z-order accessors (HangContext, OverlayService sweep) have no consumer on this head. Icons: divergent by decision: fluent-icons 2026-10-10 (lane icons-studio-features; WPF emoji/glyphs drawn as Fluent fx:IconGlyph/IconLabel/StrBare; before/after ~/ccp-port/evidence/icons/icons-studio-features/).
win-descent-fuseConditioningControlPanel/Windows/DescentFuseWindow.xaml, DescentFuseWindow.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/DescentFuseWindow.axaml, DescentFuseWindow.axaml.csstubrender-all; lines Core DescentFuseCopy (CoreStandInTests DescentFuseSurfacesShowCoreDescentFuseCopy). Shows retired like WPF: WPF DescentFuseWindow.ShowsRetired = true (ConditioningControlPanel/Windows/DescentFuseWindow.xaml.cs:173, owner 6.11.0: the cracked-screen animation "might just confuse people now") makes Open() return null for every kind; Avalonia DescentFuseWindow.Open carries the same const, so the live zero (MainShellWindow.DescentFuseShows.cs, answered-account guard from WPF DescentShowDirector.cs:147) and an owed catch-up open nothing, mark nothing and start no retry. The one path WPF still acts on - zero noticed late with no crack owed (DescentShowDirector.cs:192-196) - starts the post-zero retry over SyncPush on the shared Core DescentPostZeroRetry budget/stops (15 x 60 s). PanicSurfaces descent-fuse closes any show (WPF MainWindow.StartStop.cs:525). The window is still drawn and testable via internal OpenShow (stage visual: row ctrl-descent-fuse-stage-visual; bloom resync uses SyncPush). Tests: DescentFuseDirectorTests (retired paths open/mark/retry nothing; late no-crack retry bounded and stopped; panic), DescentFuseLiveTests.ZeroOpensNoLiveShow_RetiredLikeWpf, AccountSeedTests.FuseBloomAndPostShowRetryUseTheExistingSync (real SyncPush against fake HTTP). Remaining lane wire-win-descent-fuse-b: room audio. Earlier Keincheck (win-descent-fuse-live.txt) predates the retirement port and is superseded. The ceremony hand-off is dead on both heads (3aa4801fb): WPF IsCeremonyOpen => false (ConditioningControlPanel/Services/Descent/DescentMigrationService.cs:66), Avalonia passes ceremonyOpen: false; nothing to port there.

Follow-up lane wire-win-emi-codex-b (likely shared with wire-win-emi-desk-b): the desk Fire/Speak moment bus on Avalonia EmiDeskService and the ask bubble (WPF EmiDeskWindow.Bubble.cs ShowAsk/BuildChips/AnswerAsk, none of which exist on this head), then MaybeOfferSoon (summon>=2 route, tour-finish, 20 s delay, re-arm, ever/1 cadence) -> bookOffer -> book:open -> existing EmiDeskWindow.OpenBook (WPF EmiOffers.RunBook -> EmiBook.Open), and the unreachable codex host/page/bridge with local origin lockdown, bookmark, target/tour actions and runtime/navigation/process fallbacks. Keep the WPF-unreachable plain reader without an invented UI opener.

LauncherFxTests.SpeakerButton_ByRealClick_MutesQuietly_UnmutesWithANote (real pointer press; fail-proven twice: slash not repainted, toggle removed; ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-launcher-failproof.txt); live sandbox invoke -> slash shown, settings false, invoke -> true, 0 binding errors (~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-launcher/win-launcher-speaker.txt); render ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-launcher/win-launcher-render.png. Leash gate before play (mine-launcher-account, WPF LauncherHost.cs:360-366, MainWindow.Leash.cs:95-108): Play asks MainShellWindow.LeashBlocksGames and a pending punishment opens the panel with PresentLeashGateFromLauncher instead of the tab; both are provider seams nothing seeds yet (no Leash service on this head), so live it never blocks. LauncherFxTests.Play_UnderALeashPunishment_GoesToTheGate fail-proven (leashBlocks forced false -> red). Additional source evidence: Shell: title bar (wordmark, minimize, close), panel card (banner, eyebrow, title, blurb, Launch CTA), games grid seated by Core LauncherGridLayout, cards from Core LauncherCards with WPF's rim, fade, pills (Sign in to play / Prime / NEW) and Play/Locked/Sign in button; only destinations this head has are drawn (Graded Intake -> panel on the tab; signed-out opens the login dialog owned by the launcher). Every game card hidden until its host exists (docs/avalonia-decisions.html). Account row + panel card (launcher-account): sign-in pill (signed out) / account chip (initial, name, Patreon tier badge with hover popup, SP chip) opening App Settings; mod pill (Mod: <name>, menu in Core LauncherModMenu order with the active one ticked + Manage mods -> panel Mod Manager; a pick goes through the panel's SwitchActiveModFromLauncher); CoreMods.ModChanged repaints the pill and redraws the tiles via Core LauncherTileRefresh; panel card status (Not running / Running since HH:mm from CoreEngine.StartedUtc, Stop link -> StopEngine, CTA Launch/Open), Level / Sparkle Points / Time under and XP bar + caption on a 1 s tick. LauncherWindowTests.AccountChip_*, PanelCard_*, ModPill_* fail-proven; live sandbox text ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port-launcher-account/win-launcher.txt (pill, Mod: CCP Default, 4 / 42 / 1h 35m / 120 / 865 XP, 0 binding errors; mod menu not opened live: the window reports Minimized on this desktop). FX (launcher-fx, LauncherWindow.Fx.cs): WPF's backdrop (radial base, two turning spirals at 10 fps, glow + pool + vignette, AmbientFxCanvas fog/dust/aurora), hover lift 1.02 + tilt toward the pointer + tile DropShadow glow 0.35->0.7 + the hue bleeding into the backdrop glow, the Play/CTA exit beat (pop, two shockwave rings, burst + echo, the rest dims to 0.55, decaying shake; the hide held FadeLeadMs then a 220 ms fade-out), a locked/signed-out flinch, welcome-back bursts, edge flare/breath/glint (open, focus back every >=4 s, idle 14 s), a 260 ms fade-in, and the cues (open, click on every button, hover melody via Core LauncherMelody (git mv), denied, launch, edge, return) through CoreAudio, gated on LauncherSoundEnabled and master volume. One frame clock steps it all, only while shown and not minimised and only while something moves; motion Off/Reduced/Performance gate it as WPF does. LauncherFxTests (10, stepped clock incl. real-pointer hover and the hover throttle on an injected TimeProvider; each fail-proven, red output ~/ccp-port/evidence/launcher-fx/fail-proofs.txt); spirals park on Deactivated; off-screen Play (game boot, handoff) is silent; a fade guard timer forces the hide; a close drops a pending exit. Not run live (port 3001 contention). Missing: cursor parallax, Ken-Burns art drift, the tile-art slide against the tilt, art HoverPop, the locked-tile tier rim (TierFxBorder), sparkle trail + stars, perimeter comets (tile, running panel card + rim breath), CTA/wandering/wordmark sheens, wordmark drift, running-dot breath, hover title tint, embers layer (no Avalonia layer), three-voice hover cap and output-suppressed probe (CoreAudio returns no handle), odometer/bar tweens and the tier badge wobble, GrantsChanged redraw (no grant service here), friends chip/What's new, mystery card. Media pill, shortcut link + tile shortcut button (.desktop on Linux, .lnk on Windows, compile-only): mine-launcher-links (LauncherLinksTests, live ~/ccp-port/evidence/mine-launcher-links/). Skip-to-panel box (launcher-boot): bottom-right, shows and saves LauncherSkipToPanel (WPF SkipToPanel_Click; the click cue comes from the window-wide Button.Click handler, a CheckBox being a Button here); LauncherWindowTests.SkipToPanelBox_ShowsAndSavesTheSetting fail-proven; live toggle saved true and the next boot opened the panel (~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port-launcher-boot/win-launcher-boot-bare.png, win-launcher-handoff.txt). render-all; Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/LauncherWindowTests.cs; ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/launcher-core/win-launcher-live.png. Lockdown veil (lockdown-veil, LauncherWindow.Veil.cs): WPF's #D9070310 veil over every row with launcher_lockdown_veil (9 languages, Core), toggled by LockdownActivated/Deactivated, red vignette + text breath (3 s, sine, auto-reverse) on a 30 fps tick that runs only while the veil and the launcher are shown and ambient loops are allowed; keys are swallowed at the window (tunnel) so Tab/Enter/Space reach nothing veiled (WPF leaves focus alone) and focus moves to the veil. LockdownVeilTests.LauncherVeil_FollowsLockdown_SwallowsClicksAndKeys_BreathesOnlyWhileShown fail-proven (veil toggle, key swallow, hit test, hidden-launcher tick); not run live (the veil only shows when something other than the panel starts a Lockdown while the launcher is up). Belt and braces kept: StopLink_Click calls MainShellWindow.RefuseStopUnderLockdown() and ModPill_Click/SwitchMod refuse while LockdownActive (tests Lockdown_StopLinkRefuses_EngineKeepsRunning, Lockdown_ModPillOpensNoMenu_AndSwitchModRefuses; 1 s timer stop on hide: StatusTimer_StopsWhenTheLauncherHides). Games (launcher-games): no game host or window exists on this head (Back Room, Breakout, Piece by Piece, Racing Thoughts, DtRH, Arcademy, Goon), so their tiles stay hidden, there is no mystery card (its Back Room destination is absent), and WPF's return poll / exit beat / raise-game (LauncherHost.cs:335-450) have nothing to wait on and are not built; they land with the first host. Tile Play, the signed-out card press, the sign-in pill, the panel CTA and the account chip refuse under Lockdown in place of WPF's veil (Lockdown_TilePlayRefuses_LauncherStaysAndPanelStaysTucked, Lockdown_SignedOutCardPress_AndSignInPillOpenNoLogin (real pointer press), Lockdown_PanelCtaAndAccountChip_LeaveThePanelTucked; each guard fail-proven, ~/ccp-port/evidence/launcher-games/lockdown-failproofs.txt); the intake test now clicks the real tile button. Leash gate before play (mine-launcher-account, WPF LauncherHost.cs:360-366, MainWindow.Leash.cs:95-108): Play asks MainShellWindow.LeashBlocksGames and a pending punishment opens the panel with PresentLeashGateFromLauncher instead of the tab; both are provider seams nothing seeds yet (no Leash service on this head), so live it never blocks.
win-layered-audioConditioningControlPanel/Windows/LayeredAudioWindow.xaml, LayeredAudioWindow.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/LayeredAudioWindow.axaml, LayeredAudioWindow.axaml.cs; CCP.Avalonia/Platform/LayeredAudio.csverifiedOpens single-instance from Settings > Audio (BtnAudioLayers) and the Home dashboard button; drives Platform/LayeredAudio.cs (WPF LayeredAudioService rules, one looping LibVLC player per track, cubic-mapped linear gain, cooperative duck from LibVlcAudio.Duck/Unduck). Proof: Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/LayeredAudioTests.cs; --layers-probe asserting exact per-stream pactl percentages ({100,79} -> {100,58} -> still {100,58} after looping a 0.23 s clip -> [58] after Restart -> none); Keincheck run with a temp profile: master on -> 2 CCP sink-inputs at 100%/79%, layer-2 slider -> 56% (held across loops), layer-1 toggle off -> [56%], master off -> 0 (win-layered-audio-live-run2.txt); evidence ~/ccp-port/evidence/layered-audio/. Not ported: WPF's EnsureOnScreen clamp, audio-only session start (no session engine on this head), output-device choice (see shell-audio-playback-devices). Snapshot lock: Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Snapshot.Tests/Snapshots/win-layered-audio.verified.png. Icons: divergent by decision: fluent-icons 2026-10-10 (icons only; snapshot re-baselined, pair ~/ccp-port/evidence/icons/icons-studio-features/pairs/LayeredAudioWindow.png; lane icons-studio-features; WPF emoji/glyphs drawn as Fluent fx:IconGlyph/IconLabel/StrBare; before/after ~/ccp-port/evidence/icons/icons-studio-features/). win-lock-cardConditioningControlPanel/Windows/LockCardWindow.xaml, LockCardWindow.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/LockCardWindow.axaml, LockCardWindow.axaml.cswiredTyped solve at WPF parity: answers go through Core LockCardText (ellipsis/curly quotes/dashes/NBSP/invisibles folded; LockCardTextTests moved to Core), session phrase unbound from its loc key, Deactivated focus reclaim, 52x52 lock glyph, each card sized to its screen (KWin will not maximize a CanResize=False window, so the live card was a clipped 300x200 box), and the success pulse/shake now actually run (they threw before, so a correct repeat never registered). LockCardTypingTests; Keincheck live run: Test button, 3 typed repeats, card completed and closed, binding errors 0 (kc cannot capture the card window, so the picture is ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/lockcard-typed-parity/lockcard-render.png from --render-view). Strict Esc honours the X11 panic listener (PanicKeyTests). Voice solve (lockcard-voice): WPF :338-342 gate (requested + CoreSpeech.IsAvailable + MicConsentGiven), :956-1089 listen loop on the Core SpeechEngine, DisableVoiceForAll filled; LockCardVoiceTests (WAV-fed: spoken phrase completes, wrong phrase stays open, 6 unavailable -> typing), panel frames in ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/lockcard-voice/; no live voice run (kc cannot capture the card, and a live card would open the real default mic). No-model hint names the Linux folder (UserData/Models/vosk), no-consent and close-mid-listen privacy tests. Mic hand-off: an armed wake/PTT loop is stood down for the card and re-armed after (voice-commands). Missing: achievement/NotifyCompleted services, Win32 per-screen device-pixel placement, the TypoMade event (WPF LockCardWindow.xaml.cs:763, feeds the Remote Control screen preview; nothing raises it here). Fluent icons (icons-voice): header 🔐, voice-state glyphs (🎤 ✓ 🔊 ✗) and the ✨ completion mirror are Fluent icons (state swaps set IconLabel.Kind; LockCardVoiceTests asserts Kind Dismiss); divergent by decision: fluent-icons 2026-10-10 (renders ~/ccp-port/evidence/icons/icons-voice/).
linux-package-vosk-modelinstaller/publishpackaging/linux/build-tarball.shwiredThe linux-x64 tarball bundles vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15 under Resources/Models/vosk (fetched by .github/scripts/fetch-vosk-model.sh), the first root SpeechEngine.DefaultModelRoots probes. --smoke with CCP_SMOKE_BUNDLED_VOSK=1 requires the model to load (fails NoModelFound when removed from the tarball); passes from the extracted tarball and from /opt after makepkg -si in an archlinux container: ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/linux-package/. CI runs it on ubuntu. Not verified: no Keincheck voice run from an installed package.
linux-packageinstaller/publishpackaging/linux/, packaging/aur/PKGBUILDwiredInstalled run (linux-package-wired, 7.1.5): the CI tarball built locally, installed into a temp prefix the AUR way (now written up as the hand install in docs/avalonia-linux-install.html, snippet run verbatim), .desktop Exec resolved via PATH; installed --smoke passes; a real start in a throwaway kwin_wayland --virtual --xwayland (no Xvfb/weston here) reaches the interactive First run wizard, WM_CLASS = app id, and closing it (WM_DELETE_WINDOW) exits 0; packaging/aur/test-local.sh passes; ldd closure inside depends= (~/ccp-port/evidence/linux-package-wired/). Performance: installed 749 MiB (tarball 534 MB); splash 0.46 s, first interactive window 5.80 s after launch (one cold-cache-ish run). Not covered: a real makepkg -si/pacman install (no sudo; bwrap-bound /opt instead), a clean-machine depends= proof. Tarball (reproducible tar; LICENSE; share/ with .desktop + StartupWMClass, 128/256px icons, appstream metainfo; app id io.github.CodeBambi.ConditioningControlPanel) built, extracted and smoked locally and in CI (artifact only, never a release). AUR conditioning-control-panel-bin consumes it: makepkg -si + --smoke pass in archlinux:latest; sha256sums is SKIP until a release pins it. Re-verified for 7.0.5 (package-verify): pkgver was stale at 6.11.3 (fixed; smoke-tarball.sh now fails on the mismatch); Docker down on the dev box, so packaging/aur/test-local.sh (host makepkg + bwrap-bound /opt, pacman -T on depends=) runs the installed launcher's --smoke, fail-proven 3 ways; ldd closure of the bundled .so files is inside depends= (~/ccp-port/evidence/package-verify/). In-app (linux-inapp-deps): Core CCP.Core/Services/LinuxDependencies.cs dlopens the table's libraries (webkit2gtk 4.1/4.0, WPE trio, libvlc, libsecret, libX11/libXi) and reads /etc/os-release for the one pacman/apt/dnf command (unknown distro: library list as the fallback); a startup toast with Copy command (App.axaml.cs) and the WebHost panel (+ Copy button) show it. Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/LinuxDependenciesTests.cs per family + fake probe, fail-proven 4 ways. PortalPanicShortcut calls org.freedesktop.host.portal.Registry.Register(io.github.CodeBambi.ConditioningControlPanel) first on its connection; live --portal-check + dbus-monitor: with the .desktop installed (Exec stand-in) Register ok and the impl CreateSession carries our app id, without it refused and filed under org.kde.konsole (~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/linux-inapp-deps/). Not verified: the toast/panel with a library really missing (every library is installed here), physical BindShortcuts under the new id. Not covered: fresh-VM acceptance per channel (manual). WPE (distro-check F2): in the Arch pacman command only (extra ships the trio; pacman -Si 2026-10-10); Debian/Fedora/unknown get no WPE package names and a line saying those pages are unavailable, no Flatpak offered since none ships (linux_dep_wpe_unavailable, LinuxDependenciesTests.MissingWpeSaysUnavailableNotAPackageCommand, ArchInstallsWpeWithPacman). PortalPanicShortcut calls org.freedesktop.host.portal.Registry.Register(io.github.CodeBambi.ConditioningControlPanel) first on its connection; live --portal-check + dbus-monitor: with the .desktop installed (Exec stand-in) Register ok and the impl CreateSession carries our app id, without it refused and filed under org.kde.konsole (~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/linux-inapp-deps/). Not verified: the toast/panel with a library really missing (every library is installed here), physical BindShortcuts under the new id. Not covered: fresh-VM acceptance per channel (manual). linux-package-flatpakinstaller/publishpackaging/flatpak/io.github.CodeBambi.ConditioningControlPanel.ymlblockedManifest (GNOME 50, bundled minimal libVLC 3.0.21, tray own-name, tarball share/ + LICENSE) is written and parses but has never been built: no flatpak-builder/GNOME Sdk on the dev box. Blocked on the first flatpak-builder run, which must also settle WPE (the user brief says bundle it; the manifest does not, see avalonia-decisions.html Linux package shape) and the StatusNotifierItem own-name. package-verify: the tarball smoked inside the installed org.gnome.Platform//50 runtime passes everything but LibVLC (the bundled module); the runtime lacks the WPE trio (~/ccp-port/evidence/package-verify/flatpak-runtime-*.txt/log). Still no flatpak-builder/Sdk and Docker cannot start containers. Missing: own Flatpak repo + .flatpakref.
win-mantraConditioningControlPanel/Windows/MantraWindow.xaml, MantraWindow.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/MantraWindow.axaml, MantraWindow.axaml.cswiredSession half ported (mantra-service): Core CCP.Core/Services/MantraService.cs (git mv) drives the window: typed line -> TryCompleteMantra (XP 30+min(streak5,50), quests, next line, box cleared), idle 5 s breaks the streak (Chaster note), completion overlay + 5 s auto-close, events unsubscribed on close; opened bare (render proof) it starts a MantraDefaultCount session, a deviation (render ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/mantra-service/win-mantra-render.png). Drone + tones via CCP.Avalonia/Platform/ToneWav.cs (LibVLC layer / CoreAudio.PlayOneShot, no NAudio); drone opens muted at WPF's raw 0.05, MantraDroneVolume from the first ramp step; app/tray exit closes the window, disposes the drone and deletes the WAVs (App.StopMantra). rows-mantra-window: all five Storyboards ported as tweens stepped off the float timer on MantraWindow.Clock (pulse 1.06/0.15 s on a line, letter-pulse 1.02/0.08 s on a right letter, wrong-shake 4/-4/3/-3 px on a wrong letter, shake 8/-8/6/-6/3 px on a broken streak, glow 0->0.3 over 2 s reversed forever; WPF xaml:14-58); panic surface mantra (PanicSurfaces, WPF KillAllAudio -> Mantra?.Dispose()) ends the session and also stops the drone WPF left humming; the Programs Mantra-task door (WPF #1230 BtnProgramOpenMantras_Click -> StartMantraSession(reps), ProgramTaskItem.OpenVisible/OpenReps) is in the today-task template. wire-win-mantra: the user path is live since programs-run-3b: the Programs run view builds TodayTaskList and a Mantra task's door (WPF :1149, OpenVisible/OpenReps) opens the window at the task's reps via OpenProgramMantrasAsync -> StartMantraSession (ProgramsRunControlsTests.LoadedRunThisHeadCannotFinishSaysSoAndOpensTheMantraDoor now clicks the door through to the open window, fail-proven by dropping the StartMantraSession call, red output ~/ccp-port/evidence/wire-win-mantra/fail-proofs.txt). Reach is narrower than WPF's: only kept carries Mantra tasks and this head refuses to enroll kept (KeywordTrigger not raised; blocker row shell-programs-tab), so a Linux-only user cannot reach the Mantra Lab door today; it shows only for a kept run loaded from a Windows profile. StartMantraSession's failure MessageBox is ported (WPF's "Mantras" / "Couldn't start the mantra session:\n\n{message}" through MessageDialog; MainShellWindow.NewMantraWindow seam; MantraWindowSessionTests.FailedOpenShowsWpfsWarning, fail-proven by dropping the dialog, same log; wait bounded at 10 s). Tests Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/MantraWindowSessionTests.cs (StoryboardsStepOnTheClock, PanicStopsTheDroneAndEndsTheSession, ProgramTaskDoorOpensTheMantraLabAtTheTaskReps, FailedOpenShowsWpfsWarning; each fail-proven: 5 storyboard lines, panic StopDrone, door reps; log ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-mantra-window/fail-proofs.txt), Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/MantraServiceTests.cs (fail-proven x7). No Keincheck run yet; drone/tone not heard live; tween smoothness not measured. No Keincheck run (no user path to open it); drone/tone not heard live; tween smoothness not measured. Session half ported (mantra-service): Core CCP.Core/Services/MantraService.cs (git mv) drives the window: typed line -> TryCompleteMantra (XP 30+min(streak5,50), quests, next line, box cleared), idle 5 s breaks the streak (Chaster note), completion overlay + 5 s auto-close, events unsubscribed on close; opened bare (render proof) it starts a MantraDefaultCount session, a deviation (render ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/mantra-service/win-mantra-render.png). Drone + tones via CCP.Avalonia/Platform/ToneWav.cs (LibVLC layer / CoreAudio.PlayOneShot, no NAudio); drone opens muted at WPF's raw 0.05, MantraDroneVolume from the first ramp step; app/tray exit closes the window, disposes the drone and deletes the WAVs (App.StopMantra). rows-mantra-window: all five Storyboards ported as tweens stepped off the float timer on MantraWindow.Clock (pulse 1.06/0.15 s on a line, letter-pulse 1.02/0.08 s on a right letter, wrong-shake 4/-4/3/-3 px on a wrong letter, shake 8/-8/6/-6/3 px on a broken streak, glow 0->0.3 over 2 s reversed forever; WPF xaml:14-58); panic surface mantra (PanicSurfaces, WPF KillAllAudio -> Mantra?.Dispose()) ends the session and also stops the drone WPF left humming; the Programs Mantra-task door (WPF #1230 BtnProgramOpenMantras_Click -> StartMantraSession(reps), ProgramTaskItem.OpenVisible/OpenReps) is in the today-task template. wire-win-mantra: the user path is live since programs-run-3b: the Programs run view builds TodayTaskList and a Mantra task's door (WPF :1149, OpenVisible/OpenReps) opens the window at the task's reps via OpenProgramMantrasAsync -> StartMantraSession (ProgramsRunControlsTests.LoadedRunThisHeadCannotFinishSaysSoAndOpensTheMantraDoor now clicks the door through to the open window, fail-proven by dropping the StartMantraSession call, red output ~/ccp-port/evidence/wire-win-mantra/fail-proofs.txt). Reach is narrower than WPF's: only kept carries Mantra tasks and this head refuses to enroll kept (KeywordTrigger not raised; blocker row shell-programs-tab), so a Linux-only user cannot reach the Mantra Lab door today; it shows only for a kept run loaded from a Windows profile. StartMantraSession's failure MessageBox is ported (WPF's "Mantras" / "Couldn't start the mantra session:\n\n{message}" through MessageDialog; MainShellWindow.NewMantraWindow seam; MantraWindowSessionTests.FailedOpenShowsWpfsWarning, fail-proven by dropping the dialog, same log; wait bounded at 10 s). win-media-historyConditioningControlPanel/Windows/MediaHistoryWindow.xaml, MediaHistoryWindow.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/MediaHistoryWindow.axaml, MediaHistoryWindow.axaml.cswiredrows-media-history: MediaHistoryService + MediaHistoryPreviewRules moved to CCP.Core (WPF App.xaml.cs feeds Flash/Video events); Avalonia App creates/disposes it, FlashOverlay records images, MandatoryVideoScheduler.LastVideoPath records clips. Window (Assets tab > Media Log) reads the real log, live EntryAdded/Cleared, All/Images/Videos/Audio filters + search + count, row thumbnails (96 px LRU), folder button hidden for online rows, preview plan (file-not-found / audio card / streamed-only + Copy link (Copied 2 s) + Go to Source), muted looping video via LibVLC, animated GIF via SkiaSharp, Clear behind a confirm. wire-win-media-history: reveal SELECTS the file (WPF ExplorerLauncher) through ExternalOpener.Reveal: Explorer /select on Windows, open -R on macOS, freedesktop FileManager1.ShowItems (dbus-send) on Linux, the folder when the file is gone or the desktop cannot select; the Explorer command line moved to CCP.Core/Helpers/RevealArguments.cs (WPF ExplorerLauncher calls it). BtnPreviewLoad (Load preview) ported: shown only for an online still with remote-media consent, fetches into memory, following redirects by hand (5 hops, https->http refused, the guarded handler re-checks each host; WPF RemoteMediaCache follows them) (no RemoteMediaCache on this head, so the free RemoteCached path never applies), 720 px decode off the UI thread, generation guard, label_no_preview / streamed-only + retry on failure. The MediaFailed plate: MediaHistoryPreviewRules.VideoLooksBroken (empty, non-video bytes, or a strict container with no video head) shows label_file_not_found before LibVLC, which raised no error for an unreadable mp4. Tests: Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/MediaHistoryWindowTests.cs (both facts, incl. MediaLog_reveals_the_file_and_loads_an_online_still_only_with_consent clicks BtnPreviewLoad, Online_still_fetch_follows_redirects_by_hand_and_stops_at_five_hops), Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/RevealArgumentsTests.cs, Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/MediaHistoryServiceTests.cs, MandatoryVideoSchedulerTests.VideoStarted_fires_when_the_clip_is_shown. Compiled, not run: the Windows explorer.exe /select and macOS open -R branches of ExternalOpener.SelectNative, and WPF ExplorerRevealArgumentTests (WPF test project builds on Linux, cannot run). Live: ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-media-history/ (row0-5, video-a/b and gif-a/b frames differ, audio-filter, 0 binding errors). win-mini-playerConditioningControlPanel/Windows/MiniPlayerWindow.xaml, MiniPlayerWindow.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/MiniPlayerWindow.axaml, MiniPlayerWindow.axaml.cswiredVideo playback is REAL (WPF behaviour: silent :no-audio preview, loop at end, play/pause button + Space, seek slider on release, 100 ms position timer, mm:ss time, Left/Right ±5 s, Esc/close, drag; teardown stops, disposes and frees the frame buffer). Proof: --video-check <file> [png] on the real desktop (frames change, seek to 70% lands at 0.70, pause freezes frames and flips the glyph, close disposes player/bitmap/buffer and LibVLC's threads end: 31 -> 21) and the same check headless in Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/MiniPlayerVideoTests.cs (skips without ffmpeg/libvlc); fail-proofs and screenshot in ~/ccp-port/evidence/video-miniplayer/. GIFs loop (WPF AnimationBehavior RepeatBehavior Forever): the still first frame shows at once, frames decode off the UI thread through SpiralOverlay's SkiaSharp decoder and a frame timer loops them until close (deviation: SpiralFrames caps 1280 px / 120 frames by stride / 300 MB cache, every frame at the first frame's delay, a delay outside 20-500 ms plays at 50 ms; decode logs say "Spiral:"). Load failures (image, video, LibVLC missing) show WPF's notice through MessageDialog (title_error + msg_image_load_failed / msg_video_load_failed / msg_video_playback_not_available_libvlc_not_initi), deferred to Opened because LoadFile runs before Show, then close. Tests Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/MiniPlayerPreviewTests.cs (GIF loop stepped by hand + teardown; broken image -> notice -> close; each fail-proven, ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-mini-player/failproofs.txt). Opener (wire-win-mini-player): the Library tab's thumbnail double-click (WPF ThumbnailItem_Click: the first click toggles, ClickCount 2 previews) and context-menu Preview open it owned by the shell (AssetsTabView.OpenAssetPreview, WPF MainWindow.Assets.cs:1206); closing it re-activates the shell only while our process owns the foreground (WPF GetForegroundWindow pid check; AssetsTabView.AppInFront: Windows reuses EscapeClaim.CcpInFront, compiled not run here; elsewhere 'one of our windows is active', read at Closing). Tests AssetsTabTests.DoubleClickingAThumbnailOpensItInTheMiniPlayer (headless input never counts a double click, so the second press is raised with ClickCount 2) and AssetsTabTests.ContextMenuPreviewOpensAndClosingReactivatesTheShellOnlyWhileWeOwnTheForeground (fail-proven both ways: no re-activate -> 1/0; unguarded -> 0/1; double-click opener removed -> no preview; log ~/ccp-port/evidence/wire-win-mini-player/fail-proofs.txt). A zero foreground handle re-activates, as WPF MainWindow.Assets.cs:1241 does (CcpInFront(noForegroundCounts: true); the panic Escape check keeps false). WPF panic does not close the preview (not in GameSurfaces; it plays muted), so no PanicSurfaces line. Not here: pack-file previews (WPF temp-extracts pack entries) wait on the Content Packs tree node, which this head does not build yet (content-packs rows). No Keincheck run. Not here: pack-file previews (WPF temp-extracts pack entries) wait on the Content Packs tree node, which this head does not build yet (content-packs rows). No Keincheck run. Icons: divergent by decision: fluent-icons 2026-10-10 (lane icons-studio-features; WPF emoji/glyphs drawn as Fluent fx:IconGlyph/IconLabel/StrBare; before/after ~/ccp-port/evidence/icons/icons-studio-features/). Earlier merged evidence: Video playback is REAL (WPF behaviour: silent :no-audio preview, loop at end, play/pause button + Space, seek slider on release, 100 ms position timer, mm:ss time, Left/Right ±5 s, Esc/close, drag; teardown stops, disposes and frees the frame buffer). Proof: --video-check <file> [png] on the real desktop (frames change, seek to 70% lands at 0.70, pause freezes frames and flips the glyph, close disposes player/bitmap/buffer and LibVLC's threads end: 31 -> 21) and the same check headless in Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/MiniPlayerVideoTests.cs (skips without ffmpeg/libvlc); fail-proofs and screenshot in ~/ccp-port/evidence/video-miniplayer/. GIFs loop (WPF AnimationBehavior RepeatBehavior Forever): the still first frame shows at once, frames decode off the UI thread through SpiralOverlay's SkiaSharp decoder and a frame timer loops them until close (deviation: SpiralFrames caps 1280 px / 120 frames by stride / 300 MB cache, every frame at the first frame's delay, a delay outside 20-500 ms plays at 50 ms; decode logs say "Spiral:"). Load failures (image, video, LibVLC missing) show WPF's notice through MessageDialog (title_error + msg_image_load_failed / msg_video_load_failed / msg_video_playback_not_available_libvlc_not_initi), deferred to Opened because LoadFile runs before Show, then close. Tests Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/MiniPlayerPreviewTests.cs (GIF loop stepped by hand + teardown; broken image -> notice -> close; each fail-proven, ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-mini-player/failproofs.txt). Proof: --video-check <file> [png] on the real desktop (frames change, seek to 70% lands at 0.70, pause freezes frames and flips the glyph, close disposes player/bitmap/buffer and LibVLC's threads end: 31 -> 21) and the same check headless in Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/MiniPlayerVideoTests.cs (skips without ffmpeg/libvlc); fail-proofs and screenshot in ~/ccp-port/evidence/video-miniplayer/. Still stub: no production opener (WPF opener MainWindow.Assets.cs:1233 asset preview click; the Avalonia Library tree/thumbnails are held back on App.ContentPacks), so no Keincheck run on it; GIFs show their first frame only (no animated-GIF renderer); load failures log and close without WPF's MessageBox. Icons: divergent by decision: fluent-icons 2026-10-10 (lane icons-studio-features; WPF emoji/glyphs drawn as Fluent fx:IconGlyph/IconLabel/StrBare; before/after ~/ccp-port/evidence/icons/icons-studio-features/). Additional historical evidence (superseded where current evidence above closes a gap): Video playback is REAL (WPF behaviour: silent :no-audio preview, loop at end, play/pause button + Space, seek slider on release, 100 ms position timer, mm:ss time, Left/Right ±5 s, Esc/close, drag; teardown stops, disposes and frees the frame buffer). Proof: --video-check <file> [png] on the real desktop (frames change, seek to 70% lands at 0.70, pause freezes frames and flips the glyph, close disposes player/bitmap/buffer and LibVLC's threads end: 31 -> 21) and the same check headless in Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/MiniPlayerVideoTests.cs (skips without ffmpeg/libvlc); fail-proofs and screenshot in ~/ccp-port/evidence/video-miniplayer/. GIFs loop (WPF AnimationBehavior RepeatBehavior Forever): the still first frame shows at once, frames decode off the UI thread through SpiralOverlay's SkiaSharp decoder and a frame timer loops them until close (deviation: SpiralFrames caps 1280 px / 120 frames by stride / 300 MB cache, every frame at the first frame's delay, a delay outside 20-500 ms plays at 50 ms; decode logs say "Spiral:"). Load failures (image, video, LibVLC missing) show WPF's notice through MessageDialog (title_error + msg_image_load_failed / msg_video_load_failed / msg_video_playback_not_available_libvlc_not_initi), deferred to Opened because LoadFile runs before Show, then close. Tests Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/MiniPlayerPreviewTests.cs (GIF loop stepped by hand + teardown; broken image -> notice -> close; each fail-proven, ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-mini-player/failproofs.txt). Opener (wire-win-mini-player): the Library tab's thumbnail double-click (WPF ThumbnailItem_Click: the first click toggles, ClickCount 2 previews) and context-menu Preview open it owned by the shell (AssetsTabView.OpenAssetPreview, WPF MainWindow.Assets.cs:1206); closing it re-activates the shell only while our process owns the foreground (WPF GetForegroundWindow pid check; AssetsTabView.AppInFront: Windows reuses EscapeClaim.CcpInFront, compiled not run here; elsewhere 'one of our windows is active', read at Closing). Tests AssetsTabTests.DoubleClickingAThumbnailOpensItInTheMiniPlayer (headless input never counts a double click, so the second press is raised with ClickCount 2) and AssetsTabTests.ContextMenuPreviewOpensAndClosingReactivatesTheShellOnlyWhileWeOwnTheForeground (fail-proven both ways: no re-activate -> 1/0; unguarded -> 0/1; double-click opener removed -> no preview; log ~/ccp-port/evidence/wire-win-mini-player/fail-proofs.txt). A zero foreground handle re-activates, as WPF MainWindow.Assets.cs:1241 does (CcpInFront(noForegroundCounts: true); the panic Escape check keeps false). WPF panic does not close the preview (not in GameSurfaces; it plays muted), so no PanicSurfaces line. Not here: pack-file previews (WPF temp-extracts pack entries) wait on the Content Packs tree node, which this head does not build yet (content-packs rows). No Keincheck run. Missing: the host fx primitives (every fx id but the five big beats page-fx.js draws is acked skipped 'unknown', WPF BackRoomBridge.OnFx), media deal's online/mixed sources, animation header probe and words, the rest of BuildInit (lex, audio, motion, gates), Escape/fullscreen/heartbeat, and the other games (Back Room, Breakout full, DtRH, Arcademy, Goon); their tiles stay hidden and there is no mystery card. Tile Play, the signed-out card press, the sign-in pill, the panel CTA and the account chip refuse under Lockdown in place of WPF's veil (Lockdown_TilePlayRefuses_LauncherStaysAndPanelStaysTucked, Lockdown_SignedOutCardPress_AndSignInPillOpenNoLogin (real pointer press), Lockdown_PanelCtaAndAccountChip_LeaveThePanelTucked; each guard fail-proven, ~/ccp-port/evidence/launcher-games/lockdown-failproofs.txt); the intake test now clicks the real tile button. Main-sync folds (port-social): 239c1ae6e Lobby chip with a dropdown of open tables (LauncherWindow.Lobby.cs, OpenTables) and the 53b81238c launcher look; needs the Lobby service (see views-tab-available-subjects). Its 7.1.5 look (d0001dd5e): Sky chip, dimmed once seen, opening the drop marks Social seen (LauncherWindow.Lobby.cs LobbyChipOpacity). Whole-card launch + once-per-window grow to seat every tile row (sync6-launcher-badges): LauncherWindowTests.WholeCard_*, OverflowingTiles_* fail-proven (~/ccp-port/evidence/sync6-launcher-badges/fail-proofs.txt); grow not run live (Wayland ignores Position; one tile never overflows here). Speaker (rows-launcher, LauncherWindow.Sound.cs, WPF LauncherWindow.Sound.cs + xaml:452-464): title-bar cone/waves/slash toggles and saves LauncherSoundEnabled, dims the cone to 0.45, bound mute/unmute tooltip (Core strings, 9 languages); muting is silent, unmuting answers with one click (window-wide click cue runs after the handler). LauncherFxTests.SpeakerButton_ByRealClick_MutesQuietly_UnmutesWithANote (real pointer press; fail-proven twice: slash not repainted, toggle removed; ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-launcher-failproof.txt); live sandbox invoke -> slash shown, settings false, invoke -> true, 0 binding errors (~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-launcher/win-launcher-speaker.txt); render ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-launcher/win-launcher-render.png. Leash gate before play (mine-launcher-account, WPF LauncherHost.cs:360-366, MainWindow.Leash.cs:95-108): Play asks MainShellWindow.LeashBlocksGames and a pending punishment opens the panel with PresentLeashGateFromLauncher instead of the tab; LeashHead seeds both (leash-gate-card), and the panel shows the gate card (see feat-leash). LauncherFxTests.Play_UnderALeashPunishment_GoesToTheGate fail-proven (leashBlocks forced false -> red). Merged duplicate row also said: Every game card hidden until its host exists (docs/avalonia-decisions.html). Media pill, shortcut link + tile shortcut button (.desktop on Linux, .lnk on Windows, compile-only): mine-launcher-links (LauncherLinksTests, live ~/ccp-port/evidence/mine-launcher-links/). Games (launcher-games): no game host or window exists on this head (Back Room, Breakout, Piece by Piece, Racing Thoughts, DtRH, Arcademy, Goon), so their tiles stay hidden, there is no mystery card (its Back Room destination is absent), and WPF's return poll / exit beat / raise-game (LauncherHost.cs:335-450) have nothing to wait on and are not built; they land with the first host. Leash gate before play (mine-launcher-account, WPF LauncherHost.cs:360-366, MainWindow.Leash.cs:95-108): Play asks MainShellWindow.LeashBlocksGames and a pending punishment opens the panel with PresentLeashGateFromLauncher instead of the tab; both are provider seams nothing seeds yet (no Leash service on this head), so live it never blocks. Additional ledger evidence (historical limitations are superseded by the current evidence above): Missing: cursor parallax, Ken-Burns art drift, the tile-art slide against the tilt, art HoverPop, the locked-tile tier rim (TierFxBorder), sparkle trail + stars, perimeter comets (tile, running panel card + rim breath), CTA/wandering/wordmark sheens, wordmark drift, running-dot breath, hover title tint, embers layer (no Avalonia layer), three-voice hover cap and output-suppressed probe (CoreAudio returns no handle), odometer/bar tweens and the tier badge wobble, GrantsChanged redraw (no grant service here), gear/media dialog, shortcuts, friends chip/What's new, mystery card. Earlier retained evidence (may describe an earlier implementation): Shell: title bar (wordmark, minimize, close), panel card (banner, eyebrow, title, blurb, Launch CTA), games grid seated by Core LauncherGridLayout, cards from Core LauncherCards with WPF's rim, fade, pills (Sign in to play / Prime / NEW) and Play/Locked/Sign in button; only destinations this head has are drawn (Graded Intake -> panel on the tab; signed-out opens the login dialog owned by the launcher). Every game card hidden until its host exists (docs/avalonia-decisions.html); the Breakout demo's host exists (games-host). Account row + panel card (launcher-account): sign-in pill (signed out) / account chip (initial, name, Patreon tier badge with hover popup, SP chip) opening App Settings; mod pill (Mod: <name>, menu in Core LauncherModMenu order with the active one ticked + Manage mods -> panel Mod Manager; a pick goes through the panel's SwitchActiveModFromLauncher); CoreMods.ModChanged repaints the pill and redraws the tiles via Core LauncherTileRefresh; panel card status (Not running / Running since HH:mm from CoreEngine.StartedUtc, Stop link -> StopEngine, CTA Launch/Open), Level / Sparkle Points / Time under and XP bar + caption on a 1 s tick. LauncherWindowTests.AccountChip_*, PanelCard_*, ModPill_* fail-proven; live sandbox text ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port-launcher-account/win-launcher.txt (pill, Mod: CCP Default, 4 / 42 / 1h 35m / 120 / 865 XP, 0 binding errors; mod menu not opened live: the window reports Minimized on this desktop). FX (launcher-fx, LauncherWindow.Fx.cs): WPF's backdrop (radial base, two turning spirals at 10 fps, glow + pool + vignette, AmbientFxCanvas fog/dust/aurora), hover lift 1.02 + tilt toward the pointer + tile DropShadow glow 0.35->0.7 + the hue bleeding into the backdrop glow, the Play/CTA exit beat (pop, two shockwave rings, burst + echo, the rest dims to 0.55, decaying shake; the hide held FadeLeadMs then a 220 ms fade-out), a locked/signed-out flinch, welcome-back bursts, edge flare/breath/glint (open, focus back every >=4 s, idle 14 s), a 260 ms fade-in, and the cues (open, click on every button, hover melody via Core LauncherMelody (git mv), denied, launch, edge, return) through CoreAudio, gated on LauncherSoundEnabled and master volume. One frame clock steps it all, only while shown and not minimised and only while something moves; motion Off/Reduced/Performance gate it as WPF does. LauncherFxTests (10, stepped clock incl. real-pointer hover and the hover throttle on an injected TimeProvider; each fail-proven, red output ~/ccp-port/evidence/launcher-fx/fail-proofs.txt); spirals park on Deactivated; off-screen Play (game boot, handoff) is silent; a fade guard timer forces the hide; a close drops a pending exit. Lockdown veil (lockdown-veil, LauncherWindow.Veil.cs): WPF's #D9070310 veil over every row with launcher_lockdown_veil (9 languages, Core), toggled by LockdownActivated/Deactivated, red vignette + text breath (3 s, sine, auto-reverse) on a 30 fps tick that runs only while the veil and the launcher are shown and ambient loops are allowed; keys are swallowed at the window (tunnel) so Tab/Enter/Space reach nothing veiled (WPF leaves focus alone) and focus moves to the veil. LockdownVeilTests.LauncherVeil_FollowsLockdown_SwallowsClicksAndKeys_BreathesOnlyWhileShown fail-proven (veil toggle, key swallow, hit test, hidden-launcher tick); not run live (the veil only shows when something other than the panel starts a Lockdown while the launcher is up). Assets/web/backroom/bridge.js now also speaks the Avalonia string carrier (invokeCSharpAction out, __ccpRnPush in, as intake/web-shim.js), so Back Room pages are hosted on WebKitGTK. Piece by Piece (feat-pbp-host) and Racing Thoughts (game-race, behind RacingAccess) are registered too. win-pop-quizConditioningControlPanel/Windows/PopQuizWindow.xaml, PopQuizWindow.xaml.cs, Services/Quiz/PopQuizService.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/PopQuizWindow.axaml, PopQuizWindow.axaml.cs, PopQuizHost.cswiredSchedule/defer/drop policy + question bank in Core PopQuizScheduler (PopQuizSchedulerTests); Avalonia PopQuizHost is the IPopQuizHost: opens the topmost window with the mod-resolved pool, chimes via CoreAudio, lock-card check via LockCardWindow.IsAnyOpen, and a one-slot defer that replays when the last lock card closes (LockCardWindow.AllClosed; no InteractionQueueService on this head). CoreEngine arms it on Start when PopQuizEnabled and stops it on Stop; OnEngineStopped force-closes any quiz (WPF StartStop.cs:393/492/521). Graded Intake "Test pop quiz" opens one. Sessions: Core SessionRunner starts it at session start when the user toggle is on, stops + closes it on pause/panic, restarts it on Resume, stops it at the end, and the snapshot restores the rate only - since 7.1.5 (WPF f30b54f31) never the toggle, so a mid-session switch-off sticks (SessionRulesTests.Snapshot_RestoreIsByteIdentical_AndCoversExactlyWpfFields, fail-proven) (WPF SessionEngine.cs:1628/527/574/372); the per-session PopQuiz* fields are dead in WPF too (BuiltInPrograms.cs:430), so no parity gap. Test SessionRunnerTests.PopQuiz_FollowsTheUserToggle_ThroughPauseResumeAndStop (fail-proven 4x); live 3-min session: quiz at +46 s, tray panic closes it, none while paused, back 43 s after Resume, closed at the end (~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/session-runner-popquiz/). XP: calls CoreProgression.AddXP(25); this head banks no XP yet (no provider). A lock card waits while a quiz is open and replays when it closes (#763, WPF LockCardService.cs:157). Test Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/PopQuizHostTests.cs (fail-proven twice). Live (Keincheck, sandbox, 100/h, ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/popquiz-avalonia-open/): Start -> quiz ~44 s; answering shows the affirmation + "+25 XP" and closes; Stop closes an open quiz (<43 ms incl. the check); a test lock card defers it and it replays on card close; Test button opens one; arming broken -> no quiz in 75 s; 0 binding errors. Look: render-view only (Keincheck captures the main window). Not verified: avatar mute/restore (no avatar tube), SeasonRecap tracking (service head-side). 7.1.5 (f154640bb, sync6-715-fixes): the card's quiet "Turn these off" link (mouse, or Enter/Space when focused) switches PopQuizEnabled off, re-syncs the Graded Intake switch (PopQuizWindow.TurnedOff), closes like Esc (no XP) and stops the schedule; PopQuizHostTests.TurnOffLinkSwitchesQuizzesOffAndSyncsTheIntakeSwitch (fail-proven: event and Stop removed), render ~/ccp-port/evidence/sync6-715-fixes/144-popquiz-turnoff.png.

win-quizConditioningControlPanel/Windows/QuizWindow.xaml, QuizWindow.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/QuizWindow.axaml, QuizWindow.axaml.cswiredWired, but hidden in WPF too (pending removal): the only opener is Graded Intake BtnStartQuiz (WPF MainWindow.Lab.cs:116), which is IsVisible="False" on both heads. The handler is ported: it focuses an existing window, shows the login-required dialog (msg_you_need_to_be_logged_in_to_use_the_ai_quiz) when CoreAi is unavailable, and otherwise opens the window. Categories come from QuizStore.GetAllCategories. The AI round trip stays head-side, so each turn takes WPF's reply-unusable branch: QuizStore.GetFallbackQuestion and GetFallbackProfile (QuizService.cs:116/140/223). The window scores, saves via QuizStore.SaveEntry, and shows the trend (WPF QuizWindow.xaml.cs:467/659); session generation is gated on the saved entry. Fixed two port bugs, both animations run against the transform instead of the Visual, which threw InvalidCastException: the score pulse and the surrender shake. Test: Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/QuizWindowStaticTests.cs covers the gate, a full 10-answer run, the golden key shape of quiz_history.json, the trend and the report score. It was fail-proven 4 ways (fail-proofs in ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/quiz-window-static/). No Keincheck because there is no user path, as in WPF. Still stub: AI generation, effects roll, drone, RaiseQuizCompleted/XP (head-side bridge). win-settings-paletteConditioningControlPanel/Windows/SettingsPaletteWindow.xaml, SettingsPaletteWindow.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/SettingsPaletteWindow.axaml, SettingsPaletteWindow.axaml.cs; MainShellWindow.NavSearch.cswiredCore SettingsPaletteIndex remains the shared index. Search/recents/no-hits/old-name hints/row verbs/right-click favourites are retained from sync6-nav-search. wire-win-settings-palette connects PlayZone to the existing Play wall ScrollToZone (Games search + Enter resets a scrolled wall), and registers settings-palette in PanicSurfaces (non-Escape panic closes without consuming Escape grace). Evidence: NavSearchTests.GamesRowReturnsToTheGamesZoneAfterTheWallWasScrolled, PanicClosesThePaletteWithoutConsumingAnEscapePress (both observed failing before fix), GameRowUsesTheLaunchersLeashGate, existing palette tests and PanicSurfacesTests; fail-proof logs ~/ccp-port/evidence/review-wire-win-settings-palette/. Slice 5 (webcam-calibration): the 16-point sampling and fit over WebcamTracker (timing, retries, sample stretch, pose gate, fit, inaccurate-fit redo, blink check, save to the WPF profile file via Core WebcamCalibrationFit, which WPF calls too), sounds, calibrated-monitor placement; Escape/panic restores the old calibration (never undoing a revoke) and saves nothing; the save is atomic. rows-webcam-windows: Verify shows a live pink gaze cursor in the window for 15 s on the window clock (WPF GazeDebugCursorService idle dot; lock-on gold not ported, trail added by -b below), unsubscribed on stop/close. rows-webcam-windows: Verify shows a live pink gaze cursor in the window for 15 s on the window clock (WPF GazeDebugCursorService idle dot, without its trail/lock-on gold), unsubscribed on stop/close. wire-win-webcam-calibration: the bubble test is ported (WPF RunBubbleTestAsync): four probes in the WPF mirror-pair layout, dwell ring on the rolling-mean ellipse, live pink cursor, gaze attractor via Core GazeLock now run by WebcamTracker (SetGazeAttractor/ClearGazeAttractor, LastPreLockGaze), pop sound + scale/fade pop stepped on the window clock, near-miss samples, auto-fix trim applied and saved (ApplyGazeTrim), WPF summary text; panic/Escape close clears the attractor at once. Rules are Core BubbleAccuracyTest + GazeTrimData.Compose, which WPF now calls too. Follow-up wire-win-webcam-calibration-b: both mouth prompts now subscribe to WebcamTracker.OnMouthOpen; real capture frames feed Core MouthOpenDetector after the blink step and not when both irises are missing (WPF WebcamTrackingService :1716/:1740 order), and WPF calls the same detector (three-chord MAR, median-of-3, 90 closed frames / 10th percentile baseline, sensitivity-scaled speech floor, 250 ms minimum opening / 800 ms cooldown, one fire per held opening). Capture-run identity drops queued mouth events after stop. Verify and bubble cursors draw a pink geometry comet (paints cached per fade step, redrawn only while the trail changes) with shared Core GazeCursorTrail (64 nodes, 3 DIP step, .55 s life, .1 s age cap), which WPF's cursor now calls too. The trail runs on the window clock, clears on face loss and immediately stops on expiry/bubble exit/close/panic; gesture handlers unsubscribe on close. Focused synthetic numerical/event-route/lifecycle tests and headless render cover these behaviors, each fail-proven via rcheck (WebcamCalibrationTests: MouthPrompts_* by dropping the first prompt's subscribe, Tracker_UsesCoreMar* by dropping the null-run guard, Tracker_LiveCapture* by dropping the run check, CursorTrail_* by not clearing on face loss, runs 39701941741/39702509741; WebcamMouthAndTrailTests: Geometry by dropping a chord, Reopening by a 0 ms cooldown, Trail by a 65-node cap, run 39702385239; MedianTiming by raw MAR, HighClosedBaseline by an unconditional .28 hysteresis, SensitivityAndSpeechFloor by a fixed scale, run 39702714633; mutations batched per run, each test's failure as predicted). views-tab-blink-trainerConditioningControlPanel/Views/Tabs/BlinkTrainerTabView.xaml, ConditioningControlPanel/Views/Tabs/BlinkTrainerTabView.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Tabs/BlinkTrainerTabView.axaml, CCP.Avalonia/Views/Tabs/BlinkTrainerTabView.axaml.cswiredSame as shell-blink-trainer: session start/stop, countdown, Error row, live preview, Quick Recal and Calibrate work; eye-logo blink loop ported. rows-blink-trainer: BlinkTrainerStageMedia -> BlinkTrainerStageVideo Image fed by a VlcFrameSink; HelpBtnBlinkTrainer carries the BlinkTrainer HelpPopover (WPF MainWindow.Presets.cs:118). Side art: AdaptiveSideArt.CollapseBelow=860 (shared CCP.Avalonia/Helpers/AdaptiveSideArt.cs, lane adaptive-side-art) collapses the art column below 860 DIP and holds it collapsed until 908 DIP; wire-views-tab-blink-trainer adds the real-tab resize proof BlinkTrainerResponsiveTests.Tab_ResizingCollapsesArt_HoldsAcrossScrollbarWidths_AndRestoresColumns (fail-proven). Corrected stale stage-animation note: WPF BlinkTrainerTabView.xaml:210-211 uses plain Image controls and MainWindow.BlinkTrainer.cs:534-548 freezes a BitmapImage with no animation hook; stage still-frame behavior matches WPF. GIF/WebP animation in the separate session overlays (BlinkTrainerService.BuildTile) belongs to shell/session scope, whose existing limitations remain.
