views-tab-chasterConditioningControlPanel/Views/Tabs/ChasterTabView.xaml, ConditioningControlPanel/Views/Tabs/ChasterTabView.xaml.cs, ConditioningControlPanel/Views/Tabs/ChasterTabView.Fx.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Tabs/ChasterTabView.axaml(.cs)stubRead-only slice: header + account chip (lock, time left, chaster.app link), hero (title as LockTitle, see ctrl-lock-title, live d/h/m/s clock, ends line, setup hint, state pills), lock pick (one-tap / combo), unlinked ask with the Core loopback link flow + cancel + outcome note, the three facts; slice 2: Unlink (confirm dialog, revoke, token cleared from SecretStore, UI back to unlinked), Run-the-tab switch + one-time consent card (four facts), Pause pill (WPF :865-1072). Slice 3 (chaster-ladder): heads-up clock, raffle card and ladder scrap (see views-chaster-ladder-scrap). Slice 4 (chaster-receipt): the three numbers (balance, today + cap meter, this run) with the tab's receipt under them (ChasterTabView.Numbers.cs), the calendar sheet on Core LockCalendar (ChasterTabView.Calendar.cs: torn sheet + pin, cross/ring/padlock/key/elided cells + tooltips; crosses are straight strokes, no draw-in, no tonight tag) and 4. THE KEYS 2x2 on Core TabPresets (ChasterTabView.Keys.cs: rewrites ChasterPrices + RequestLimits, custom key rewrites nothing, stakes lines, Circe's mood refreshed as WPF RefreshPresets :1123; keys never touch the lock so no import confirm); a 30 s slow tick refreshes the hero (WPF :89) so the calendar rolls at midnight. ChasterBillTests TheRunNumberOpensTheReceiptAndALanguageSwitchRepaintsIt (no fail-proof recorded), TheCalendarDrawsOneSquareADayFromCore (also CalendarSpan UTC->local + null/no-end/hidden snapshot; fail-proven by dropping ToLocalTime and by dropping the hidden-timer guard; the null-snapshot path is asserted, not separately fail-proven), AKeyRewritesThePricesAndLightsItself (Gentle->Strict shows the MoodMeter, day/backlog limits; fail-proven by dropping RefreshMood and by dropping the limits write); the 30 s tick has no test; --render-view ChasterTabView draws all three with sample data. Missing: ground (spiral/glow/ambient), hero art, paper tag, tonight's calendar tag, switch/consent Fx (FxSwitch/FxConsentShown/FxConsentOk), limits, the row trailer, the footer facts row and all Fx (FxBill, FxPreset/FxKeyTurned, calendar draw-in included). HapticsTabView.Dials.cs ports the rest of MainWindow.Haptics.cs: real provider chips, the four routing groups (one open row), toy cards fed by DevicesChanged with the #977 shape guard, toy count/empty state, per-toy test, DtRH ambient/density, audio-sync delay/power (mirrored to Settings · Audio via AudioSettingsBinder.Changed, as WPF :943/:958) and the card gate on the audio-sync row, temperament, toy input + cooldown, FunScript (+stop on off), flash brightness (+zero layer on off), band split + six DSP sliders + reset, 1 Hz override/FunScript badges only while attached and visible (P01), pattern lab preview/picker/play. Test Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/HapticsHeadTests.cs TabShowsRealToysRowsAndWritesDialsThrough (mock toys only; fail-proven by breaking card build, the visibility gate, the DevicesChanged hook, the sync-card gate, the DSP write and the Settings mirror). Live ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/rows-haptics-tab/: chips Lovense/Intiface/Mock (demo) and the real routing rows (1-provider-chips.txt, 4-routing-rows.txt), Tease chip saved temperament: tease (6-temper.txt, 7-saved-temperament.txt), 0 binding errors. Not driven against a real toy or Intiface (sandbox has no premium, so the page is veiled); wire-views-tab-haptics: the Tier-1 side-art column is back (HapticsSideArt, WPF HapticsTabView.xaml:901: 3*/2* split, settings column MaxWidth 780, scrim, vibe.png painted mod-first by ApplyFeatureArt) behind a head port of WPF Features/AdaptiveSideArt.cs (CCP.Avalonia/Helpers/AdaptiveSideArt.cs, CollapseBelow=1000: folds the last column, hides the plate, lifts the settings MaxWidth); the #1321 hysteresis rule moved to Core CCP.Core/Helpers/SideArtCollapse.cs (WPF AdaptiveSideArt delegates). Only Haptics uses the head property so far; the other 23 views stay under feat-adaptive-side-art. Trunk 5acf94a5f (HC10) imported: toy Test and pattern Play hang off one page CancellationTokenSource that ends on a rack module switch (the page itself is hidden) or when it leaves the tree; leaving Studio only hides StudioTab, so a preview keeps running until it ends or Panic, and HapticService.PanicStop (Core, so WPF too) now also cancels a per-toy test that drives the provider around the mixer (PanicSurfaces "haptics" already routes there). Tests Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/HapticsHeadTests.cs Tier1SideArtShowsWideAndFoldsBelowTheThreshold (fail-proven by dropping CollapseBelow from the page), PagePreviewStopsOnHideAndToyTestStopsOnPanic (fail-proven by reverting the PanicStop change), Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/SideArtCollapseTests.cs. Difference from WPF: Avalonia also stops the page's own buzz (Test/Play) on a rack module switch (the test hides the page directly, not through the rack); WPF MainWindow.Haptics.cs:663/1087 has no preview cancel and lets it run out. Note: the page StackPanel is centred (as on WPF), so the region is as wide as its content; in the default 1100x780 render it stays under 1000px and the plate is folded. The plate has only been seen in the headless test that sizes the Grid to 1200px; no render or real-shell check shows it yet, and whether WPF folds at the same window width is not measured. WPF AdaptiveSideArt.cs edit compiled only through the WPF test project build, not run. Live ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/rows-haptics-tab/: chips Lovense/Intiface/Mock (demo) and the real routing rows (1-provider-chips.txt, 4-routing-rows.txt), Tease chip saved temperament: tease (6-temper.txt, 7-saved-temperament.txt), 0 binding errors. Not driven against a real toy or Intiface (sandbox has no premium, so the page is veiled); wire-views-tab-haptics: the Tier-1 side-art column is back (HapticsSideArt, WPF HapticsTabView.xaml:901: 3*/2* split, settings column MaxWidth 780, scrim, vibe.png painted mod-first by ApplyFeatureArt) behind a head port of WPF Features/AdaptiveSideArt.cs (CCP.Avalonia/Helpers/AdaptiveSideArt.cs, CollapseBelow=1000: folds the last column, hides the plate, lifts the settings MaxWidth); the #1321 hysteresis rule moved to Core CCP.Core/Helpers/SideArtCollapse.cs (WPF AdaptiveSideArt delegates). Trunk 5acf94a5f (HC10) imported: toy Test and pattern Play hang off one page CancellationTokenSource that ends on a rack module switch (the page itself is hidden) or when it leaves the tree; leaving Studio only hides StudioTab, so a preview keeps running until it ends or Panic, and HapticService.PanicStop (Core, so WPF too) now also cancels a per-toy test that drives the provider around the mixer (PanicSurfaces "haptics" already routes there). Tests Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/HapticsHeadTests.cs Tier1SideArtShowsWideAndFoldsBelowTheThreshold (fail-proven by dropping CollapseBelow from the page), PagePreviewStopsOnHideAndToyTestStopsOnPanic (fail-proven by reverting the PanicStop change), Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/SideArtCollapseTests.cs. Difference from WPF: Avalonia also stops the page's own buzz (Test/Play) on a rack module switch (the test hides the page directly, not through the rack); WPF MainWindow.Haptics.cs:663/1087 has no preview cancel and lets it run out. Note: the page StackPanel is centred (as on WPF), so the region is as wide as its content; in the default 1100x780 render it stays under 1000px and the plate is folded. The plate has only been seen in the headless test that sizes the Grid to 1200px; no render or real-shell check shows it yet, and whether WPF folds at the same window width is not measured. views-tab-graded-intakeConditioningControlPanel/Views/Tabs/GradedIntakeTabView.xaml, ConditioningControlPanel/Views/Tabs/GradedIntakeTabView.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Tabs/GradedIntakeTabView.axaml, CCP.Avalonia/Views/Tabs/GradedIntakeTabView.axaml.csstubPass gate ported (WPF MainWindow.Lab.cs:343): IntakePassService moved to Core (git mv; entitlement hooks passed in by each head), seeded in App.axaml.cs with CoreEntitlement.IntakePassAvailableProvider; the view paints Premium/Available/Spent/NeedsLogin (gate, banner, disabled launch zone, copy) on attach, language change and PassStateChanged (which also fires on either provider's TierChanged). Begin Intake runs WPF's pass + AI gates (Lab.cs:148: login dialog, spent toast with See tiers). TierChanged hooks attach in AccountSeed.Seed() (where the providers are built); sign-in/out repaints via UpdateQuickLoginUI (WPF Patreon.cs:294). Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/GradedIntakeGateTests.cs (fail-proven: unhooked PassStateChanged; no attach in Seed; no RaiseChanged on login). Live Keincheck, fresh sandbox: signed-out gate shows the sign-in copy over a disabled launch zone, 0 binding errors (~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/graded-intake/views-tab-graded-intake-needslogin.{png,txt}); Available/Spent/Premium only headless (no sign-in in a sandbox). Intake host slice 1 (intake-host): run rules moved to Core IntakeRun (WPF IntakeHostService delegates; Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/IntakeRunTests.cs, fail-proven); CCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/IntakeHostWindow.cs (WebHost + invokeCSharpAction/__ccpRnPush bridge) spends the pass only on a parsed quiz-result (Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/IntakeHostWindowTests.cs, fail-proven; ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/intake-host/). Intake page slice (intake-page): Begin Intake opens IntakeHostWindow on the WebAssetServer token URL (origin-fenced; messages only from the served document incl. port), answers "ready" with WPF's init (niche, caps, ccp.assets media under the server's ccp.assets/ prefix, subjectId, ai null in a sandbox), fires the achievement signals (AchievementEngine.TrackQuizCompleted/Abandoned), refreshes the Sessions list and shows the "Run it now" toast; bridge injection proven at document start from the adapter IL. Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/IntakePageTests.cs, IntakeHostWindowTests.cs, Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/IntakeRunTests.cs, AchievementEngineTests.cs (each fail-proven). Corner-GIF option panel (WPF MainWindow.Presets.cs:515-636): shown for HasCornerGifOption sessions with the session's localized corner_gif_desc, a picked row resets it unticked, the toggle reveals the settings, Select GIF (StorageProvider, images folder) labels the button, size/opacity stamp "{n}px"/"{n}%" (loc bindings removed from those labels), Start writes it into the session (StartSession :1586), and #474 live edits reach a running session (corner pick at once; size AND opacity on the 400 ms debounce - ponytail: WPF's opacity edit is instant). The session-scoped corner GIF now runs: Core SessionRunner (WPF SessionEngine.cs:198/356/531/575/862-896/1731-1797/2126-2320) raises it at start when admitted, re-asks admission every tick and on RefreshCornerGifPolicy (Spiral card's session switch, a standalone slot change, the fullscreen spiral leaving), delayed start/end minute (ours: no re-raise past the end minute, WPF flickers), hides it on pause, hands the corner back on the terminal close; admission rules moved to Core CornerGifPlanner (WPF CornerGifMedia forwards). CornerGifOverlay draws it as a session slot (no stagger, no Spiral-Library fallback, outside the standalone sentinel); standalone slots stand down while it is up; panic closes it (corner-gif surface) and pauses the session. Card sheen (WPF OnPresetsTabVisibilityChanged/RefreshCardSheen): on the selected preset chip or rack row while the tab is shown, the window active and not minimised, and ambient loops allowed; dropped on hide. Rack rows: action buttons only under the pointer (WPF SdRackActions; transparent, unhittable and out of the Tab order at rest, like WPF Hidden). Catalogue chip drag-over icon states: nothing to port, WPF's SessionDropZone_DragEnter/Over/Leave/Drop are never subscribed (PresetsTabView.xaml:914 hooks only MouseLeftButtonUp). Takeaway shelf rows belong to shell-takeaway (this tab paints WPF's empty state). The session-scoped corner GIF now runs: Core SessionRunner (WPF SessionEngine.cs:198/356/531/575/862-896/1731-1797/2126-2320) raises it at start when admitted, re-asks admission every tick and on RefreshCornerGifPolicy (Spiral card's session switch, a standalone slot change, the fullscreen spiral leaving), delayed start/end minute (ours: no re-raise past the end minute, WPF flickers), hides it on pause, hands the corner back on the terminal close; admission rules moved to Core CornerGifPlanner (WPF CornerGifMedia forwards). CornerGifOverlay draws it as a session slot (no stagger, no Spiral-Library fallback, outside the standalone sentinel); standalone slots stand down while it is up; panic closes it (corner-gif surface) and pauses the session. Card sheen (WPF OnPresetsTabVisibilityChanged/RefreshCardSheen): on the selected preset chip or rack row while the tab is shown, the window active and not minimised, and ambient loops allowed; dropped on hide. Rack rows: action buttons only under the pointer (WPF SdRackActions; transparent, unhittable and out of the Tab order at rest, like WPF Hidden). dialogs-display-nameConditioningControlPanel/Dialogs/DisplayNameDialog.xaml, ConditioningControlPanel/Dialogs/DisplayNameDialog.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Dialogs/DisplayNameDialog.axaml, CCP.Avalonia/Views/Dialogs/DisplayNameDialog.axaml.cs; CCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/MainShellWindow.PendingRegistration.cswiredRename and delete modes wired from the Trainer Card (BtnChangeDisplayName/BtnDeleteProfile, own card + unified id only) through CoreAccount -> Core V2AuthService.ChangeDisplayNameAsync/DeleteAccountAsync; delete signs out without a push (AccountSeed.Logout(accountDeleted)). Incoming lane update (supersedes earlier gap descriptions where implemented): All three modes have their WPF callers. Rename and delete from the Trainer Card (BtnChangeDisplayName/BtnDeleteProfile, own card + unified id only) through CoreAccount -> Core V2AuthService.ChangeDisplayNameAsync/DeleteAccountAsync; delete signs out without a push (AccountSeed.Logout(accountDeleted)). Welcome mode from the shell's Opened (WPF MainWindow_Loaded -> CheckPendingRegistrationAsync, 2 s wait, skipped for a V2 user with a UnifiedId) -> HandlePostAuthAsync -> PromptForRegistrationAsync over Core LegacyAccountApi (the V1 /auth/lookup, register, link-provider, claim; WPF AccountService now calls the same Core copy): link to the other signed-in provider's account or refuse a different one, returning user without a prompt, same-email auto-link or the create-new confirm, then the name loop (server refusal shown, claim offered, Cancel signs the provider out). 401 recovery: Core AuthRecovery (WPF ProfileSyncService.HandleUnauthorizedAsync moved; WPF now calls it, App.xaml.cs seeds its hooks): rename recovers without retrying, delete retries once only after a real recovery; AccountSeed seeds the Patreon-then-Discord re-validate and the heartbeat restart. Tests: Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/NameDialogsTests.cs (fail-proven per ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-name-dialogs/FAILPROOFS.md); Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/PendingRegistrationTests.cs (PendingRegistration_AsksForAName_ShowsAServerRefusal_ThenRegisters, _IsArmedByTheShellOpening, _Cancel_SignsTheProviderOut_AndRegistersNothing, _ReturningUser_AdoptsTheAccount_WithoutAPrompt, _Skips_AV2User_AndAUserWithNothingPending, Seed_Wires401Recovery_ToTheSignedInProvidersRevalidate; the arm and the seed test fail with their wiring removed); Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/AuthRecoveryTests.cs (Delete401_RecoversThenRetriesOnceWithTheRecoveredToken, Delete401_WithoutARecovery_DoesNotRetryAndShowsTheServersText, Rename401_RecoversTheSessionButDoesNotRetry fail without the V2AuthService change; cooldown/keep-token/provider-mint cases). Compiled, not run: the WPF head's switch to Core LegacyAccountApi/AuthRecovery (builds on Linux with EnableWindowsTargeting; Windows only at runtime). Not exercised live: the V1 endpoints and the 401 path against the real server. Live: evidence/rows-name-dialogs/. dialogs-local-ai-setup-wizardConditioningControlPanel/Dialogs/LocalAiSetupWizard.xaml, ConditioningControlPanel/Dialogs/LocalAiSetupWizard.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Dialogs/LocalAiSetupWizard.axaml, CCP.Avalonia/Views/Dialogs/LocalAiSetupWizard.axaml.cswiredEvery step drives OllamaSetupService, which moved to Core unchanged apart from a non-Windows PATH lookup: detect, start ollama serve, installer download and silent install (Windows only), model pull with progress, smoke test, Finish saving Local, Retry, and Cancel that cancels the running step. Off Windows there is no auto-install: the consent lines say to install Ollama yourself, and Continue re-detects (an error says so when Ollama is still missing; the start-failed error gives the systemctl and ollama serve commands) (docs/avalonia-decisions.html 2026-10-09). The manual-install links work from the keyboard. The head now seeds LocalAiService.EnsureServerRunning and calls StopSpawnedServer on exit. Tests: Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/LocalAiSetupWizardTests.cs (3) and Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/OllamaSetupServiceTests.cs (2), all faked with no network. Live evidence (sandbox, Engine Room → Setup local AI): ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-local-ai-wizard/wizard-text.txt, windows.json, binding-errors.txt (0 wizard errors); render: render-LocalAiSetupWizard.png. Limits: the Windows installer path has only been run against fakes. The live dialog screenshot failed in Keincheck, so there is text evidence only. The Lab-effects "set up local" entry belongs to the AiPermissionsGrid row. dialogs-loginConditioningControlPanel/Dialogs/LoginDialog.xaml, ConditioningControlPanel/Dialogs/LoginDialog.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Dialogs/LoginDialog.axaml, CCP.Avalonia/Views/Dialogs/LoginDialog.axaml.cswiredProvider sign-in runs Core's OAuth flow (LoopbackOAuth.SignInAsync, ProviderSubscription/DiscordAccount.SignInAsync; WPF services delegate; browser via Launcher, clipboard fallback), then V2 auth, existing-email confirm, name availability (WPF's three endpoints), register (provider + invite) and display-name/password login, identity via Core V2AuthService.ApplyIdentity. Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/LoopbackOAuthTests.cs (authorize URL/port/PKCE/state/messages transcribed from WPF, fail-proven). Sign in via Web runs Core V2DeviceCodeService (git mv from the WPF head; App.Settings -> CoreSettings, version via CoreReleaseContent, handler seam): initiate, ABC-DEF + verification URL, browser via ExternalOpener, WPF's poll loop (3 s first wait, 202 keeps waiting, 429/503/unknown back off x2 to 30 s, five unknowns give up, 404/400/401/410 and the server expires_at end it with WPF's wording), confirm adopts through the same Succeed tail (bare token+id fallback for an old proxy), Copy copies the raw code, Cancel/close stop polling. A sign-in link no browser takes is copied and explained (WPF BrowserLauncher.OpenUrlOrPrompt prompt, title_open_link_in_browser). Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/LoginDeviceCodeTests.cs (shell -> Settings Log in -> Sign in via Web on a stepped clock: 3 s cadence + confirm, expiry message + loop ends; link-copied prompt; fail-proven: poll start, initial wait, expiry guard, provider tag, prompt). Closing the dialog cancels the provider flow (deviation from WPF, which kept waiting: the latch + callback port blocked every retry for 5 min, user report "login does not work"); An unreachable sign-in server (no network, or a sandbox) ends a provider attempt at once with WPF's login_failed_please_try_again instead of a 5-minute spinner (proxy probe before the browser; the Account Link buttons too); Offline Mode greys the Home Login button (WPF UpdateOfflineModeUI). A Settings · Account Link waiting on the browser ends when the section leaves the tree (WPF kept waiting). Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/LoginRetryTests.cs (Cancel twice; each provider against the sandbox-refused proxy; Link; offline: asserted, not fail-proven; Link ends on leaving the section: fail-proven, ~/ccp-port/evidence/login-fix/fail-proofs.txt) + live ~/ccp-port/evidence/login-fix/ (repro-notes.md, retry-after-fix.log). While the section stays in the tree an abandoned Link still holds "Connecting" for 5 min, as WPF does (whether switching tabs detaches it is unverified). Not driven headless in the dialog: provider token exchange, register and account-login paths (Core pieces tested above); real consent unproven. Live (sandbox, proxy refused): ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-login-phone/live.txt + dialogs-login-device-code-refused.png (initiate refused -> error dialog, 0 binding errors). No WPF side-by-side. Merged duplicate row also said: Not driven headless in the dialog: provider OAuth, register and account-login paths (Core pieces tested above); real consent unproven. dialogs-mod-pickerConditioningControlPanel/Dialogs/ModPickerDialog.xaml, ConditioningControlPanel/Dialogs/ModPickerDialog.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Dialogs/ModPickerDialog.axaml, CCP.Avalonia/Views/Dialogs/ModPickerDialog.axaml.csstubUnreachable on WPF too; parity holds, nothing to wire (re-checked 2026-10-08: WPF and Avalonia method lists and x:Name lists match (Avalonia adds TitleBar and TxtDownload for the port), incl. HoverPop art, progress, offline state, guards; only ShowIfNeeded constructs the dialog on either head). No user path on either head: WPF 6.11.x removed the returning-user auto-open (MainWindow.xaml.cs:587-588) and constructs ModPickerDialog nowhere; mods are offered by the first-run wizard and the Mod Manager (see win-first-run-wizard, dialogs-mod-manager). This head follows: MainShellWindow.FirstRun.cs opens nothing for a returning user (ModChoiceTests.ReturningUserStartupOpensNoPickerAndFetchesNothing: no picker, zero requests; fail-proofed by re-adding the auto-open). The dialog itself stays ported against the live ReleaseContentService (ponytail note on ShowIfNeeded): WPF's guards with real HasPackService / IsFullInstall / ManifestUnavailable (ModPickerDialog.xaml.cs:631-647), manifest fetch on load, per-card progress, WPF BtnDownload_Click (:443-532) recording PendingModChoice. Tests: ModChoiceTests.PickerDialogDownloadsShowsProgressAndActivates, ModChoiceTests.ShowIfNeededFollowsTheLiveServiceRules, ModPickerShowIfNeededTests (fail-proofs ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/packs-mod-picker/fail-proofs.txt). The Keincheck run in that folder (dialogs-mod-picker-*.png: download with progress, Installed, shell switched to Bambi Sleep) was taken while the auto-open still existed, so it proves the dialog's flow, not a current user path. Pilot 2026-10-14: remains stub because WPF MainWindow/MainWindow.xaml.cs:515-521 explicitly removes the standalone popup and ShowIfNeeded has no caller; no trigger invented. Compiled catalogue art now bypasses active-mod overrides as WPF pack:// bindings do (ModPickerArtTests.CatalogCardsUseShippedArtEvenWhenTheActiveModOverridesEveryImage, fails on the old loader). Additional ModChoiceTests cover both close buttons during a download, retry after failed verification, and upgrader intent (no automatic switch). Windows/WPF behavior inspected in source, compiled but not run here; gate run and its limits are recorded in the PR body (Verification limits).

feat-bouncing-textConditioningControlPanel/Features/BouncingTextFeatureControl.xaml, ConditioningControlPanel/Features/BouncingTextFeatureControl.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Features/BouncingTextFeatureControl.axaml, CCP.Avalonia/Views/Features/BouncingTextFeatureControl.axaml.cs, CCP.Avalonia/Views/Overlays/BouncingTextOverlay.cswiredSettings round-trip; the overlay now exists: CoreBouncingText seeded in App -> BouncingTextOverlay (WPF Services/Subliminal/BouncingTextService.cs + BouncingTextWindow): one full-screen override-redirect click-through window per targeted screen (GlobalTargetMonitor/DualMonitorEnabled), motion/colours/effects/XP from Core BouncingTextEngine, bounds = union of targeted screens / primary scaling and per-window position = WPF UpdatePosition formula, loop per rendered frame (RequestAnimationFrame, WPF CompositionTarget.Rendering; dt clamp 0.1 s, frozen during DisplayChangeCoordinator), bold BouncingTextFont (Segoe UI fallback), black drop shadow blur 10 depth 3, or Outlined (stroke max(2, size/22), round join, pad stroke+6), scale+rotate transforms, corner-burst ring (240 DIP, 0.1->1.3 ease-out, 550 ms), live Refresh/Restart. Interaction queue, bubble-count side (WPF TriggerGame :321 TryStart(queue: true)): a game due while a mandatory video plays, a lock card or a pop quiz is up waits (no game, no Bambi Freeze), re-checks every 1 s on the TimeProvider and plays once the screen is free; a replay after engine stop or with the card switched off drops as WPF (Queued_game_drops_after_stop_or_card_off, fail-proven); panic (ForceCleanup) drops the queued game. Deviation: the handover lags up to 1 s (poll) where WPF's queue dequeues the moment the other interaction completes. feat-bouncing-textConditioningControlPanel/Features/BouncingTextFeatureControl.xaml, ConditioningControlPanel/Features/BouncingTextFeatureControl.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Features/BouncingTextFeatureControl.axaml, CCP.Avalonia/Views/Features/BouncingTextFeatureControl.axaml.cs, CCP.Avalonia/Views/Overlays/BouncingTextOverlay.cswiredSettings round-trip; the overlay now exists: CoreBouncingText seeded in App -> BouncingTextOverlay (WPF Services/Subliminal/BouncingTextService.cs + BouncingTextWindow): one full-screen override-redirect click-through window per targeted screen (GlobalTargetMonitor/DualMonitorEnabled), motion/colours/effects/XP from Core BouncingTextEngine, bounds = union of targeted screens / primary scaling and per-window position = WPF UpdatePosition formula, loop per rendered frame (RequestAnimationFrame, WPF CompositionTarget.Rendering; dt clamp 0.1 s, frozen during DisplayChangeCoordinator), bold BouncingTextFont (Segoe UI fallback), black drop shadow blur 10 depth 3, or Outlined (stroke max(2, size/22), round join, pad stroke+6), scale+rotate transforms, corner-burst ring (240 DIP, 0.1->1.3 ease-out, 550 ms), live Refresh/Restart. Arming: engine Start (the card toggle applies live only while running, as WPF). Tests Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/TextOverlayTests.cs (bounds/local placement vs WPF). Live (Keincheck, 3 screens): 3 override-redirect depth-32 windows with 0 input rects at screen bounds, window contents read back from X show the shadowed logo moving ~122 DIP/s at Speed 5, Outlined+Second+Spin restart works, Off -> 0 windows; frame pacing (Debug, 10 s windows): repaint limited to screens near the logo (IsNear) took the late-frame share (>2x median) from 0-41.5% (median ~11%) to 0.3-8.9% at 145-155 frames/s, max gap 16-47 ms (startup); gaps were bimodal 144/60 Hz, never below WPF's once-per-refresh rate; process CPU is dominated by the shell's own state (idle 2-23%), feature adds ~0-6%; closing the shell stops every overlay and the process exits (negative control without the hook: process stays alive) (~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/overlay-text-families/). ctrl-descent-fuse-stage-visualConditioningControlPanel/Controls/DescentFuseStageVisual.csCCP.Avalonia/Controls/DescentFuseStageVisual.cs, CCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/DescentFuseWindow.axaml.cswiredRedrawn for this head as one Render pass (same fixed seed, 96 sparks, 9 hairlines, sealed glyph, single flash, cubic drain, black beat, accent bloom, Year One arm with notches), immutable alpha ramps; added to StageHost and fed SetFrame/SetIgnition every show frame, accent from PinkColor/PinkBrush (WPF ResolveAccent). Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/DescentFuseRailChipTests.cs StageVisual_DrawsEachBeatLikeWpf (draw counts per beat + bloom pixel; fail-proven by dropping the hairlines) and the zero test (live show's canvas parented in StageHost; fail-proven); red runs in ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port-rows-descent-fuse/failproofs/hairlines.txt, stagehost.txt. Render: ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port-rows-descent-fuse/win-descent-fuse-render.png (spark field + standing line). Live show frame itself not captured by Keincheck.

ctrl-help-popoverConditioningControlPanel/Controls/HelpPopover.cs, MainWindow/MainWindow.Presets.cs, MainWindow.UiUpdates.cs:1708CCP.Avalonia/Controls/HelpPopover.cs, CCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/MainShellWindow.HelpButtons.cswiredHosts the drawn help loop + step chips above the text like WPF BuildLoop (rows-tutorial-help). help-attach: WPF SetupHelpButtons ported as one x:Name -> section table (all 33 WPF SetHelpContent buttons, same ids; every one has an Avalonia twin), applied from the shell ctor (InitializeHelpButtons) by a Button Loaded class handler, because most hosts load without InitializeComponent and some ? live in late-built drawers/workshop cells; ToolTip cleared like WPF Presets.cs:130; an already-attached button is left alone (no pinned card closed on reload). The Intake Pass tile ? (BtnIntakePassHelp) gets WPF's IntakePass content (punch-card tip omitted: IntakePunchCardService.UiEnabled is static readonly false). Feature cards, split cards and the Studio rack panels keep their own attach. No WPF ? without an Avalonia surface remains; WPF itself has no ? for System/MiniGame/Unlockables/Community/AppInfo/PatreonExclusives (Presets.cs:46-50,62-66,112-114). Not ported: none. Tests: HelpButtonsTests.cs - ShellTableIsWpfSetupHelpButtons (scans WPF Presets.cs, table must equal it; fail-proven by remapping HelpBtnScreenOcr), EveryHelpButtonOpensItsSectionAndEveryLoopIsReachable (shell startup -> every tab + drawer opened -> each ? attached to its id, click opens it, loop present where one exists, Intake Pass ? attached, all 23 loops reachable; fail-proven by dropping the InitializeHelpButtons() call, by remapping ScreenOcr, and by renaming the intake match; red runs in ~/ccp-port/evidence/help-attach/failproof-*.txt). Audio and BlinkTrainer no longer self-attach (BlinkTrainer re-attached on every Refresh, closing a pinned card); the table owns them; HelpPopoverTests.cs (lifecycle), HelpLoopTests.cs. Live: ~/ccp-port/evidence/help-attach/ctrl-help-popover-RemoteControl.png (rail Remote Control -> ? -> card with the RemoteControl loop, l-loopview.txt 1 HelpLoopView, l-binding-errors.txt 0 errors). Not verified: no WPF side-by-side (P35). audit-fix-misc (#1313): **word** renders as a SemiBold pink run via Core HelpMarkup (git-mv, WPF HelpTooltipBuilder.Marked); HelpPopoverTests (fail-proven). Icons: divergent by decision: fluent-icons 2026-10-10 (Fluent IconGlyph/IconLabel/StrBare replace emoji glyphs; ~/ccp-port/evidence/icons/icons-home-settings/).
ctrl-inline-loop-videoConditioningControlPanel/Controls/InlineLoopVideo.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Controls/InlineLoopVideo.cs; CCP.Avalonia/Controls/HelpPopover.cs -; CCP.Avalonia/Views/Controls/InlineLoopVideo.cs; CCP.Avalonia/Controls/HelpPopover.cs; -wiredAn Image fed by the shared LibVlcAudio.Shared LibVLC through Platform/VlcFrameSink.cs (same vmem frame copy as WPF): :input-repeat=65535 + WPF's EndReached re-play fallback, muted by :no-audio (not Mute, as WPF), hardware decoding. Lifecycle follows the visual tree where WPF's HelpPopover drove it by hand: attach starts, IsVisible=false pauses (SetPause), detach stops, disposes the player/media and frees buffer + bitmap. Deviation: an Avalonia popup detaches its content on close, so re-opening restarts the clip where WPF resumed a paused player. User path: HelpPopover's clip poster (WPF BuildVideoPoster :201, 184-px rounded pink-rimmed poster + localized caption bar) for a topic with ClipFile and no drawn loop. Today no Core topic sets ClipFile and Assets/tutorial_videos ships no clips (same dormant path as WPF). Tests Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/InlineLoopVideoTests.cs (real 1 s ffmpeg clip: first frame < 3 s, frames past the end, hidden = not playing and time frozen, unload -> no player/Source and live-player count back to baseline, reload plays; popover open plays, close releases) - fail-proven per behaviour (detach teardown, pause, loop, poster wiring); mute (:no-audio) not tested. Missing on chat: typewriter, bark echo, season-recap/achievement emits. Still stub for the other partials: animated GIF/avatar (incl. emote mode AvatarTubeWindow.CirceEmotes.cs: Circe sets and the mod-local drone-mode.ccpmod outfit emotes set1..5 from main 5e5c3ac01 show as still sprites), other reactions, chat actions, speech coupling (no giggle plays). mine-safety (38bf5fc73/dce198971 hints): panic silences the tube (AvatarTubeWindow.Panic.cs PanicSilence, WPF Speech.cs:1837-1868; registry id tube-speech, WPF MainWindow.xaml.cs:1980-1981): stops her clip (PlayStoppable; a new line cuts the previous one, WPF Speech.cs:1896), thinking/listening animations, auto-hide and bubble; the explicit-content acknowledgement opens via ShowDialogSafe (WPF ChatInput.cs:1298), so a hidden tube never throws and close/cancel never switch. Tests TubePanicTests, TubeContentGatesTests.HiddenTubeStillAsksAndCloseStillRefuses (fail-proven). mine-dnd-tube: the right-click menu acts (AvatarTubeWindow.QuickMenu.cs, WPF ChatInput.cs:867-1538): talk, engine through the shell with the #479 lock + Stop escape, trigger mode, takeover (#978 entitlement, #514 lockdown, menu = consent), mute avatar/whispers, live headers/colours, remote-controller greying; Shrink/Grow (50-150%, saved AvatarTubeScale, restored when free, reset on attach) and Dismiss (#888); a press outside the chat box closes it; closing the tube stops her voice and unhooks the ask-card singleton. Test TubeQuickMenuTests + AvatarTubeWindowingTests.DetachedRestoresSavedScale, 19 lines fail-proven (~/ccp-port/evidence/mine-dnd-tube/failproof.txt). Not ported: Pause browser (hidden: no WebHost mute), the remote emote swap, the trigger-phrase timer. Folded from views-companion-picker-card: the picker card's Look combo needs a pickable-sets list and a SelectAvatarSet(set) door on this tube (WPF AvatarTubeWindow.Avatar.cs:925-938), and its portrait wants the emote idle still (WPF EmoteIdleClipUri). Additional historical evidence: Windowing (AvatarTubeWindow.Windowing.cs) is ported and proven: attached dock via Core TubeDockPlacement (left / right fallback / float, WPF formula), follows shell move/size/state, detach = topmost + WM drag (BeginMoveDrag on avatar/bubble/title/frame), attach snaps back, mode + Left/Top persisted and restored/clamped (DIPs, decision row 2026-09-29); built at shell load when AvatarEnabled (WPF MainWindow.xaml.cs:3695). Tests Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/TubeDockMathTests.cs, Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/AvatarTubeWindowingTests.cs (fail-proven x6); Keincheck KWin/XWayland ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/avatar-tube-windowing/ (AT-live-.txt, AT-dock-left.png). Attached input region is cut to everything left of the seam (XFixes X11Overlay.SetInputRect; live shape 333x782 ends on the shell's edge, AT-input-1.txt; a real XTest click hit the lock screen, so rail routing is shown by shape + in-process click only); Attach from the tube menu restores the shell first; detached position saved on pointer release; restore picks the screen its DIPs land on (TubeWindowMath). Not ported: make-room, mirrored right-dock art, measured mod-art insets, zoom/Shrink/Grow/Dismiss, floating bob, a real WM drag (synthetic). Speech queue (mine-tube-speech, WPF Speech.cs:35-350,1842): presets wait in order behind the line on screen, spaced by the earned gap (2 s, +5 s after AI, +0.02 s/char past 100); a priority line, panic and the listening bubble drop the queue and the pending gap; every new line cuts the previous clip; hover holds a bubble 2 min max (Core SpeechLatchRule, git mv). theme-fontsConditioningControlPanel/Fonts/Fredoka.ttf (WPF: Segoe UI + system colour emoji)CCP.Avalonia/Platform/AppFonts.cs, CCP.Avalonia/Platform/SystemEmojiFontCollection.csstubInter default, bundled Fredoka/Noto Sans Mono mappings, emoji fallback = system colour emoji (own collection, fonts:SystemEmoji) then bundled Noto Emoji. Bold/italic text draws its colour emoji at the regular face: Avalonia's synthetic bold/italic copy (SkiaTypeface.TryGetStream) SIGSEGVs under GC (decision 2026-10-12, render-all-segv). Bold: no difference (0 px, measured); italic: emoji upright instead of skewed, like WPF's EmojiTextBlock inline Twemoji Images (Helpers/EmojiTextBlock.cs:11-14); plain WPF TextBlock Segoe UI Emoji slant not measured. Inter/Fredoka/bundled Noto Emoji/Noto Sans Mono/system fallbacks still use Avalonia's synthesis (residual risk). Test: Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/SystemEmojiFontCollectionTests.cs; evidence ~/ccp-port/evidence/render-all-segv/. Shared application Font.Mono now matches WPF App.xaml and is consumed through DynamicResource by UpdateFailedDialog, SpiralTabView and the Companion CmpWireTextStyle (WPF CompanionTheme.xaml:1280); all three mono family links map to bundled Noto Sans Mono off Windows. WPF FontGuard (probe for an installed-but-corrupt Cascadia/Consolas, v6.8.6) not ported: off Windows every mono link resolves to the bundled face, so the system file it guards is never opened; on Windows it remains a gap (follow-up wire-theme-fonts-b, with the non-system-emoji synthesis risk above). wire-theme-fonts-b must also move these WPF Font.Mono/FontGuard.Mono users off their hardcoded chains so a guard can swap them: DescentFuseRailChip.cs:26, CircesMoodMeter.cs:56,95, ChasterBookedFlash.cs:32, MainShellWindow.DescentFuse.cs:88, MainShellWindow.axaml:2768 (WPF MainWindow.xaml:3164), EnhancementPlayerWindow.axaml:393 (WPF :541), Invites/InvitePanel.cs:124,301 (FriendsDrawer.Mono), ChasterRailChip.cs:50. Side effect: BillboardCardHost.cs:95 already looked up Font.Mono, so the billboard eyebrow now gets the mono chain as WPF does (BillboardCardHost.cs:89). Test: Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/AppFontsTests.cs (real consumers); evidence ~/ccp-port/evidence/review-wire-theme-fonts/. Windows font selection compiled, not run; WPF comparison not run.

views-chaster-ladder-scrapConditioningControlPanel/Views/Tabs/ChasterTabView.Ladder.cs, ChasterTabView.Scrap.cs, Services/Chaster/** (raffle)CCP.Avalonia/Views/Tabs/ChasterTabView.Ladder.cs, ChasterTabView.axaml (AddedRow, LadderPopup); CCP.Avalonia/Platform/ChasterHead.cs (LadderApi)wiredHeads-up clock (roll-up + pop, hand per hour, month line), hover-opens / click-pins raffle card (unroll + staggered rows, pips, days/total, status chip, ticket date, why-not-counted line, rules link), outside press / deactivate closes a pinned card; pinned top-ten scrap (torn paper, pin, stamp, own row below a gap, settle/swing) and both opt-ins, all on Core ChasterService.Ladder. feat-first-showConditioningControlPanel/Services/FirstShow/**, Assets/web/first-showCCP.Core/Services/FirstShow/*, CCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/WelcomeShow/*, EmiDesk/EmiDeskWindow.Presentation.cs; CCP.Core/Services/FirstShow/* (rules only)stubFirst-show onboarding.
